subject: First Look: Dump Walz State Fair Sign
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_hard_hitting_state_fair&n=1)

## First Look: Dump Walz State Fair Sign
### Wednesday, August 24th 2022
Friend, Ready to get out and have some fun? The 2022 State Fair starts this Thursday and we are ready to go. Here is the first look at our 2022 State Fair Sign: [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_hard_hitting_state_fair&n=2) Many of you may remember what happened to our booth last year at the state fair. In the dead of night, leftist organizers of the state fair STOLE our King Walz sign because it was “offensive to the Governor”. That was the whole point! We then printed another sign and hung it right back up because **we will never be silenced**! Our fight for free speech garnered attention across our state and we’ve united proud patriots to fight for our God-given liberties. Surprisingly enough, we were invited back and they approved our booth design this year! Hopefully they learned their lesson. This year, we are going bigger, badder, and better than ever! You’ll see our booth on Underwood St, right by the Kidway! **But it gets even better, just a stone throw down from our booth on Underwood Street is Tyrant-wannabe Tim Walz' tiny booth. Take a look:** What a laughable excuse of a Governor! This is proof that grassroots conservative patriots in our state can lead better than this clown and his team of radical leftists. He has destroyed our state and stolen our freedom. Maybe he is trying to look humble or maybe this crazy inflation is affecting him too. We look forward to outshining this weak display every single day of the state fair because we have the truth on our side. We’ve got mountains of giveaways for people who come up and spin the wheel of Walz' Failures! Be sure to stop by for tons of fun and to chat with all of our staff and volunteers like state fair organizer Bridget, to our Big Viking Noah, to our MAGA guy Jesse Smith and even Liberty Longbeard. Action 4 Liberty is excited to chat with Minnesotans and advance liberty in our state! There will be nobody who can match our excitement, energy, and fun. This wouldn’t be possible without the grassroots donors and activists who [**fund our operations**](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_hard_hitting_state_fair&n=3). We owe a big thank you to all those who will volunteer at our booth. If you want to be a part of the action, we could still use a couple more volunteers on Labor Day weekend. **[Sign up to volunteer NOW](https://www.action4liberty.com/volunteer_state_fair_2022?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_hard_hitting_state_fair&n=4)**! Stop by and say hi to our team and volunteers and take a spin at that wheel to win great merch and continue the fight for Freedom! This is the best opportunity to meet like-minded people and expand our conservative coalition to push the ball down the field and take our freedom back! Looking forward to seeing you all there!
## **Jake Duesenberg**
**Action 4 Liberty** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_hard_hitting_state_fair&n=5 "Support Us") [Support Us](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_state_fair_booth?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_hard_hitting_state_fair&n=5)
---

This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://www.action4liberty.com/unsubscribe?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_hard_hitting_state_fair&n=6).
You can also keep up with Jake Duesenberg on [Facebook](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6nyVoJL5zCIi1gu8lCoYmQrA8P7rhuOjJmdy-IRmglie&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_hard_hitting_state_fair&n=7).
Created with [NationBuilder](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=8ZU0Lizkf4ldaLE4eHvP4jrdVLeo6TMxn9HZ_FOKnho&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=our_hard_hitting_state_fair&n=8), software for leaders.

subject: Need your help to fight climate change, create green jobs and protect our natural resources
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR |
body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I just released my environmental plan to protect Georgia’s abundant
resources, reduce greenhouse gas emissions and leverage the economic
benefits of advanced energy to secure a more resilient future.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220824_B3_EnvironmentalPolicy_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=2610%2E1862389%2EEE5VkJ ]I’m the only candidate who not only has a plan, but has the experience
to execute that plan. That’s why I’m relying on
grassroots
supporters to support my campaign and build a better
economic and environmental future for Georgia. Can I count on your support
to make my vision a reality?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220824_B3_EnvironmentalPolicy_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=2610%2E1862389%2EEE5VkJ ]DONATE

I have traveled across this state — including a trip to Coastal Georgia
just this week — and have witnessed firsthand how climate change has put
Georgians’ lives and livelihoods at risk.

Whether it's a farmer struggling with a less stable climate in Plains, or
a family facing growing threats from hurricanes and rising sea levels in
Savannah — all Georgians deserve a governor who has a plan to transition
the state into a more sustainable future.

Because right now under Brian Kemp, Georgia continues to lag behind other
states in taking action on clean energy and energy efficiency.

Our continued failure to act will compromise an estimated 25,000-40,000
jobs over the next decade and put hundreds of thousands of Georgians'
lives at risk.

That’s why as governor, I will have a plan to provide resources in the
most vulnerable areas, increase access to training for advanced-energy
jobs and safeguard the health and preservation of Georgia’s natural
resources.

I will ensure families and businesses benefit from new opportunities as
Georgia enhances its resilience and environmental protections.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220824_B3_EnvironmentalPolicy_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=2610%2E1862389%2EEE5VkJ ]But I need your help to get there. Derek,
can you please chip in now to seize this
moment, and build a more sustainable and prosperous Georgia?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1619?refcode=sa_em_220824_B3_EnvironmentalPolicy_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=2610%2E1862389%2EEE5VkJ ]DONATE

Thank you,

Stacey

P.S. I couldn’t resist sharing this photo from my marsh tour in Savannah
on Monday. subject: We're just getting started
body:

Peter, Florida Democrats nominated my opponent, and Friend, it's more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I've worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. _**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085515:6S86ZuVzN:m:1:3334294963:33CB55DEFC0E5506FBD46E7EF90BB03C:r "Stand with me to
protect our state. >>>>")**_

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that's what this fight is all about. _**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085515:6S86ZuVzN:m:1:3334294963:33CB55DEFC0E5506FBD46E7EF90BB03C:r "Join me in the fight to Keep Florida
Free. >>>>")**_

**It's not about me, it's not about my opponent, it's about you, your business, your children's education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in our approach against the Left's radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers' unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist, you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I've only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. _**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085515:6S86ZuVzN:m:1:3334294963:33CB55DEFC0E5506FBD46E7EF90BB03C:r "Rush in your support TODAY. >>>>")**_

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business' ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and _**[stand with me in the fight against the Left's schemes and radical agenda.>>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61085515:6S86ZuVzN:m:1:3334294963:33CB55DEFC0E5506FBD46E7EF90BB03C:r "stand with me in the fight against the
Left's schemes and radical agenda. >>>>")**_

Sincerely,__

body: Judicial Watch filed a Freedom of Information Act lawsuit against the National Archives and Records Administration Wednesday, demanding all communications and materials related to its referral to the Justice Department for former President Trump’s presidential records. [Action] Judicial Watch files FOIA suit against National Archives for its DOJ referral to investigate Trump records [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59908&L=27937&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanVkaWNpYWwtd2F0Y2gtZmlsZXMtZm9pYS1zdWl0LWFnYWluc3QtbmF0aW9uYWwtYXJjaGl2ZXMtZm9yLWl0cy1kb2otcmVmZXJyYWwtdG8taW52ZXN0aWdhdGUtdHJ1bXAtcmVjb3Jkcy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1hY3Rpb24rYWxlcnQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==] >From _Fox News_: Judicial Watch filed a Freedom of Information Act lawsuit against the National Archives and Records Administration Wednesday, demanding all communications and materials related to its referral to the Justice Department for former President Trump’s presidential records. [Action] Judicial Watch files FOIA suit against National Archives for its DOJ referral to investigate Trump records [==] From Fox News: Judicial Watch filed a Freedom of Information Act lawsuit against the National Archives and Records Administration Wednesday, demanding all communications and materials related to its referral to the Justice Department for former President Trump’s presidential records. The National Archives and Records Administration asked the Justice Department to review Trump’s handling of White House records in February—an investigation which ultimately led to the raid of his private residence at Mar-a-Lago earlier this month. “The Biden administration’s raid on President Trump’s home is an outrageous, reckless and unprecedented abuse of power,” Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton told Fox News Digital. “And the American people have an urgent right to know how the Biden administration manufactured the records dispute used as a pretext for the raid on Trump’s home.” Read more here [= [Contribute] [==] [32x32x1] [=] [32x32x2] [=] [32x32x3] [=] [32x32x3] [] Judicial Watch, Inc. 425 3rd St Sw Ste 800 Washington, DC 20024 202.646.5172 © 2017 - 2022, All Rights Reserved Manage Email Subscriptions [=] |

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that's what this fight is all about. __**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=24178a967fc046eb947b8f6ab50655cc&_e=dvF_JIhU73i-s2Yxa-HKBvp6oax-wBz-Pkv4V1801zvg5KRIrPVxSVU-TygwNCY2-wt96L5ZjXkQ2NWmES0ZJNlL4_8KMdT26dV_my0yrQxpn_60iTvCHmD6aN8nLZnUjSyZ00hGhW9sH9n8Omvr61uB26kUPmZ5Kfz2kzAGoOAZPGUSRRr5Pp_TB9DE2b04GnyzSgd7W5xvLOspRXx_AZs1owe05fqTdzVaNjNY-r6cR9x2KiStxUHbOsW6ovdnJgNiQErD6WpxI5sro1yuZqenRr5vytujIYG31jsGj7Cg_NYnPw0J4Auvjj3EeSI0tJLuESY9fG-MPCRHjl1AUw%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a82b8a6f1a3d03523b43db6b553c5bda68e4f30d6b509c8b9925547b24af2737a9c0b13eb8b3e770ac8cd6a5aceb624ac59")**__

**It 's not about me, it's not about my opponent, it's about you - your business, your children's education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in its approach against the Left's radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers' unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist - you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I've only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. __**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=24178a967fc046eb947b8f6ab50655cc&_e=dvF_JIhU73i-s2Yxa-HKBvp6oax-wBz-Pkv4V1801zvg5KRIrPVxSVU-TygwNCY2-wt96L5ZjXkQ2NWmES0ZJNlL4_8KMdT26dV_my0yrQxpn_60iTvCHmD6aN8nLZnUjSyZ00hGhW9sH9n8Omvr61uB26kUPmZ5Kfz2kzAGoOAZPGUSRRr5Pp_TB9DE2b049XMsERADMVlc9C8ipzTCO8LwpdxAK3igyqq3bogMkJ0UnKHRLsbNpiceMVB5gGm4_AaqXWH0Lsa_aBd5yjqcvKZgx6-YHr4Z6tpXONCRVEPv3TzHc5aqz8WnQHan-hRr26Ty_kSwSut-gz9KjWZ1dw%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a82ee90298480be1e70765f6d70f433b61f6562e3959ac8e03699ca3c1635e3a9cd7bf91b5e578c157e822512f9b87bfa44")**__

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business's ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/AndysFightLogo.PNG][https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/IMG_9106%20copy.jpeg]
Peter,
In 2017, a little movie called Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri captured the nation’s attention with its lacerating, humorous and sometimes even melancholic plot line. I was one of those folks who was taken with the premise that putting up a billboard with a punch could affect change and at the very least, draw attention to a terrible situation.
A year later, I tried out my own version when Ted Nugent, that vile, sorry, gun-worshiping excuse for a human being, was booked at Roanoke’s Berglund Civic Center for what could generously be called a “performance.” I felt it was an affront to my daughter’s memory for him to be invited to a place she called home.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/PART_1530034688939_IMG_20180626_1115171.JPEG] I tried getting the area static billboard companies to run my ads. body:
We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61089697:J1GrSuVVN:m:1:3253819041:87B19F910522F75680738218BDFE209A:r)**

You can find the original email below for reference. Thanks,
Jim

Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden's dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I'm asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61089697:J1GrSuVVN:m:1:3253819041:87B19F910522F75680738218BDFE209A:r)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61089697:J1GrSuVVN:m:1:3253819041:87B19F910522F75680738218BDFE209A:r)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it's just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It's about more freedom vs. more government control. **It's about whether we serve the government... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

**[Can I count on you for your signature?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61089697:J1GrSuVVN:m:1:3253819041:87B19F910522F75680738218BDFE209A:r)**[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61089697:J1GrSuVVN:m:1:3253819041:87B19F910522F75680738218BDFE209A:r)

| Hi Friends,
Yesterday was a terrific day for our campaigns! Here are five things to know as you head to work today:
---
---
| 1\. Congrats to Leah for a great debate!
---
| Congratulations to Leah Allen for easily winning her second debate against her primary opponent in the race for Lieutenant Governor last night. Way to go, Leah!
In case you missed it, here is a link to the full audio:
---
| | [Listen to the Debate](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AF7GZfCK1L4KPDEcBllvew51mSbzGTwDzzjE803NcsnXcTOALWEHWuH825w1lrKayGoyQAnAewJQuVQsl4BQFLDD85qNLNOzS9IDsA5QLs6NxtLvDJevPQbP-q9mGLoQLGtmU3Dt7SN5IThTR9uKsxr_doWGFnSj403wMEE1MMmKH7yjzojXyTPj28rDDJJ8TzUyE8p_a4jl77AKYSNiUxSF5b6W9OVO1W0p5IZPU_I=&c=s5tc4YP97_mljCIRY5Sn72aeR_WIQvothPDi0noet_fbhzb9DQl0hA==&ch=XX2pdFElfsE6sl4YCqpARH3d2abO_s9UODgT6vq5roQa3fTAIeNiTQ==)
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AF7GZfCK1L4KPDEcBllvew51mSbzGTwDzzjE803NcsnXcTOALWEHWuH825w1lrKayGoyQAnAewJQuVQsl4BQFLDD85qNLNOzS9IDsA5QLs6NxtLvDJevPQbP-q9mGLoQLGtmU3Dt7SN5IThTR9uKsxr_doWGFnSj403wMEE1MMmKH7yjzojXyTPj28rDDJJ8TzUyE8p_a4jl77AKYSNiUxSF5b6W9OVO1W0p5IZPU_I=&c=s5tc4YP97_mljCIRY5Sn72aeR_WIQvothPDi0noet_fbhzb9DQl0hA==&ch=XX2pdFElfsE6sl4YCqpARH3d2abO_s9UODgT6vq5roQa3fTAIeNiTQ==)
---
---
| 2\. We did it! We got the signatures!
---
| Fair and Secure MA announced yesterday that it has collected about 100,000 signatures to put the question to repeal the law giving driver's licenses for illegal immigrants on the ballot this fall. Thank you to all of the Diehl and Allen campaign volunteers who made this possible by collecting tens of thousands of these signatures in recent weeks.
Read more in Commonwealth Magazine today:
"Proponents of an initiative petition overturning a law allowing undocumented immigrants to obtain driver's licenses said on Wednesday they had gathered more than twice as many signatures as they need to put the measure on the November ballot -- and they said Diehl's campaign gathered the most signatures."
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AF7GZfCK1L4KPDEcBllvew51mSbzGTwDzzjE803NcsnXcTOALWEHWuH825w1lrKa29OCm-31Vih4bsXcV7NgNoovIB4_sRa7u-s2urtUbAJ-4WiWhGyCu5P6H4SqCAp68cR-74gsbrcsYDRl232WWaDdi5V1QGpgDLV5c9jIfV30AF1KilCoR2ohQo7rYjNfx9O9h2I4dVNotQGknkqMVL8x3dnFVLMwtEZ-McpKG_8=&c=s5tc4YP97_mljCIRY5Sn72aeR_WIQvothPDi0noet_fbhzb9DQl0hA==&ch=XX2pdFElfsE6sl4YCqpARH3d2abO_s9UODgT6vq5roQa3fTAIeNiTQ==)
---
---
| 3\. Geoff issues statement opposing student loan forgiveness
---
| "As a nation, we need to face up to the fact that there's no such thing as free money. The loan forgiveness that some people receive as a result of President Biden's action is nothing more than a bill for others. That's particularly offensive when you consider that some people who didn't have the means to attend college now will be asked to pay some of the cost of tuition for those who did. Inflation is running rampant, and for the government to pump even more money into the economy will only make matters worse. Instead, what we need to do is pull back on government spending to reduce inflation and make the cost of living -- including the cost of a college education -- more affordable for everyone. We also need to boost our overall economy so that those who graduate college will have better job opportunities to repay whatever loans they need to take to pay tuition."
\- Geoff Diehl
---
---
| 4\. Athol Daily News Interviews Geoff
---
| Geoff was recently interviewed by the Athol Daily News about a variety of subjects, including the MBTA, regional transportation and infrastructure needs, affordable housing, and mental health. Check out more of what Geoff had to say here:
---
| [Read the Athol Daily News Article](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AF7GZfCK1L4KPDEcBllvew51mSbzGTwDzzjE803NcsnXcTOALWEHWuH825w1lrKa7P_mfmdKRQ-hjJF4Wnhdc3OxCqUrVkX_rbkb4h6Co9WW0-4NmxlzlI_btXpoKgvkCCxkFVwACx5IRN7vJ2J38Xjw-IFaoxasKye4lxV-bEM5DqC2lXXjQ1uT8PdVtUxMBWOkWiW3ODFa9QxKd4zseotn69bp9_3RE1SI7v0p-8NMEzmXxgEtqghxxz3csJbc&c=s5tc4YP97_mljCIRY5Sn72aeR_WIQvothPDi0noet_fbhzb9DQl0hA==&ch=XX2pdFElfsE6sl4YCqpARH3d2abO_s9UODgT6vq5roQa3fTAIeNiTQ==)
---
---
| 5\. Early Voting Starts August 27
---
| The Republican Primary is on September 6, and early voting (in-person) will be conducted the week prior to the election. That means your first opportunity to cast your vote at the polls for Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen is coming up as soon as this Saturday! Here's a summary of some important upcoming dates:

Missouri's conservative State Attorney General, **Eric Schmitt** (R-MO), has won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate. And unlike the Republican leadership in the Senate, we are working harder than ever to win a _**conservative**_ majority this year!
Eric Schmitt ran in a crowded field of candidates and won a come-from-behind victory in a critical battleground state that will determine control of the Senate.
Now, he faces liberal Anheuser-Busch heiress **Trudy Busch Valentine** (D-MO) in the November election. Valentine has a fortune to spend in this race, and you can be sure the Left's entire political machine will be working day and night to defeat Eric Schmitt.

**The only way for him to compete financially is for us to use the strength of our numbers and bundle thousands of small-dollar donations together for him.**
**[So please take action right now and support one of the strongest conservative Senate candidates in the nation.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkbkkcod1g53ob958anac9h4pho7186j4k6g5l98_rp22sh2s8i66or4c5j64ob7chh2bs)**
Eric Schmitt is a tough, principled constitutional conservative who has fought for the rights of individuals against anti-American, anti-family elites colluding against them. During his tenure as Missouri’s Attorney General, Schmitt has been everywhere.
✓ When Democrats manipulated 2020 election rules, Schmitt leaped into the fray, leading other state attorneys general to support election integrity lawsuits in Pennsylvania and Texas.

✓ When Big Tech firms colluded to cancel conservatives from their platforms, Schmitt launched one of the nation’s most extensive investigations into their discriminatory business practices.
✓ When woke activists attacked a Missouri high school football coach for leading his players in prayer before a game, Schmitt defended the coach and made clear to school officials that he did nothing wrong under the law or the Constitution.
✓ Schmitt was also the first Attorney General to sue the Chinese Community Party and the Wuhan Institute of Virology for their criminal negligence, coverups, and lies stemming from the origins of the Covid-19 pandemic.
These were all fights of choice by Eric Schmitt. He didn’t have to wage them, and there were plenty of reasons not to. Big donors and the media don’t like culture warriors, don’t like holding leftists accountable.

**But Eric Schmitt doesn’t work for them – he works for the people. As Attorney General, he put Missouri families first. And in the Senate, he will put America First.**
**[Please help send Eric Schmitt to the U.S. Senate.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z645ftc4a1v6264cph9dn31ah2p6pu6aee5n5u00_rp22sh2s8i66or4c5j64ob7chh2bs)**

▶︎ The border crisis and the location of illegal immigrants.
▶︎ Anthony Fauci’s role in the development of Covid-19.
▶︎ The FBI’s targeting of parents as “domestic terrorists.”
▶︎ White House collusion with Big Tech on censoring conservatives.
No one will pursue the truth more doggedly than Eric Schmitt. He will join Ted Cruz, Mike Lee, Rand Paul, Ron Johnson, and others in uncovering the facts about how Joe Biden, the Democrats, and the media are trying to steal our freedom and destroy everything that made America great.
Join SCF in supporting Schmitt in Missouri’s Senate race this year. He is precisely what we need in Washington right now: a fighter, a truth-teller, and a defender of America’s Constitution and culture.

**Sydney Batch** is running for reelection in State Senate District 17, in the area of Holly Springs near Raleigh. She previously served in the State House and is a leader on issues of education, environmental protection, and health care access and affordability. She’s a steadfast champion for Wake County families.
**Rachel Hunt** knows what serving our state faithfully looks like: She’s the daughter of North Carolina’s longest-serving governor. Now, she is a member of the State House and is running to represent District 42, just south of Charlotte, in the State Senate. She’s a steadfast fighter for children and families and is a key supporter of expanding health care coverage.
**Mary Wills Bode** is an attorney, nonprofit leader, and lifelong North Carolinian. She’s now the Democratic nominee for the newly drawn State Senate District 18, north of the Raleigh-Durham area. Public service runs in Mary’s family; her mother is a former secretary of North Carolina’s Department of Health and Human Services, and her father is a retired Vietnam veteran and civic leader.
By supporting admirable candidates like Sydney, Rachel, and Mary, I believe we can block a Republican supermajority — and, who knows, maybe even break the GOP majority. As we saw in Kansas, anything is possible when committed Democrats stick together.

Friend,

Sixty years ago today, Patrick Leahy and his wife, Marcelle, were married at St. Mark's Church in Burlington, Vermont.

The senator was a law student and Marcelle had just graduated from nursing school. Together they began a life filled with children, grandchildren, friends and service to the people of Vermont.

Their 60 year marriage included 48 years in the United States Senate. Together they are one of the most impactful and beloved couples for Vermont and for our nation.

On their 60th wedding anniversary, will you take a moment to sign the virtual card we've prepared to celebrate this significant milestone?

body:
We missed our goal of finding 8,700 conservatives to sign our "Stop the IRS Petition" last week. We need your help to make sure that we hit our goal before this Friday.

| Last week, my team and I began to circulate a petition for which we were hoping to gather 8,700 signatures. The petition calls for the $80 billion recently allocated by the Democrats to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to be spent on a better cause, such as hiring 87,000 new border patrol agents.

**We didn't meet our goal, which is why I'm writing today. There is no scenario in which the federal government needs to hire 87,000 new IRS agents. None.**

If you missed taking a moment to sign my petition the first time it was sent around last week, **[please take a moment to sign it today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61096591:J9RcslVNq:m:1:3331421248:4FFD79D702CDFB35019D5FCE0C21727C:r)**

You can find the original email below for reference. Thanks,
Jim

\-----------------------------------------------

From: Jim Jordan
Date: Thu, Aug 18, 2022 at 11:33 AM
Subject: Help me stop the IRS
dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

Can I give you yet another reason why Republicans need to take back the House in November?

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump's home over "documents" just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us**.

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

Sure, the Democrats claim they are just trying to squeeze every possible penny they can out of the American people to fund Biden's dangerous agenda.**But I think there is much, much more to this power grab.**

**Ask yourself this:** __Why not use that same $80 billion to hire 87,000 new border patrol agents instead? Better yet, why not let people keep their own hard-earned money for themselves and their families?__

**Please let me know if I can count on you as an ally in the effort to stop the Biden/Pelosi agenda that is taking our money, our freedom, and our country.[I'm asking you to be among 8,700 conservatives to sign a petition to stop the government funding for the 87,000 new IRS agents. Can I count on your signature between now and Friday.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61096591:J9RcslVNq:m:1:3331421248:4FFD79D702CDFB35019D5FCE0C21727C:r)**

[** SIGN MY IRS PETITION BEFORE FRIDAY **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61096591:J9RcslVNq:m:1:3331421248:4FFD79D702CDFB35019D5FCE0C21727C:r)
**Yes, showering the IRS with funds is about Democrats wanting more of our hard-earned money.** But to me, it's just as much about the fundamental choice that Americans have faced since our founding. It's about more freedom vs. more government control. **It's about whether we serve the government... or whether the government serves us.**

I need to hear from you today: **do you support Republicans taking control of the House in November, to stop this madness and return freedom, power and money back to the people?**

**[Can I count on you for your signature?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61096591:J9RcslVNq:m:1:3331421248:4FFD79D702CDFB35019D5FCE0C21727C:r)**[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61096591:J9RcslVNq:m:1:3331421248:4FFD79D702CDFB35019D5FCE0C21727C:r)

For freedom,

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61096591:J9RcslVNq:m:1:3331421248:4FFD79D702CDFB35019D5FCE0C21727C:r)
Jim Jordan

North Carolina has the opportunity to help take back the Senate by electing Ted Budd, and defeating Biden-Buddy and radical Cheri Beasley and the Democrats' agenda of higher spending, higher prices, and less freedom. Check out Ted's interview on this great episode of Real America and share it with your friends! [](https://www.nc.gop/r?u=jalJvum2JQxpPvfjGmN5k_OHUq0sPlwZxxDgYydp98k&e=f30dc52ea6b3f0fa359c0052b3984e35&utm_source=ncgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=budd_real_america&n=1 "Tedd Budd on Real America")
* In this episode, GOP Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel sits down with the North Carolina Congressman and U.S. Senate Candidate battling to keep radical Democrats (like Biden-Buddy Cheri Beasley) from ruining this country! You'll learn more about Ted as he talks about:
* His missionary work in the former Soviet Union;
* The importance of school choice;
* The Second Amendment;
* The 2022 midterms and his critical race for Senate.
* As you know, Budd has been serving as a Congressman for North Carolina's 13th district since 2017 and now looks forward to the opportunity to represent his state as a U.S. Senator.
* He is a successful business owner and farmer who recognizes the challenges everyday Americans are now facing under the Biden administration.
* As someone who homeschools his children, Budd is a staunch advocate for school choice and parental educational involvement.
* As a lifelong North Carolinian and current Congressman, Budd knows what it takes to serve the people of the Tar Heel State.

#

**January 8, 2013**
That was the day Gabby launched our effort to make our communities safer from gun violence. While it was the two year memorial of her shooting, it was the tragedy at Sandy Hook Elementary that inspired her to begin this lifesaving work.
**April 17, 2013**
That was the day a cowardly minority of senators filibustered the passage of expanded background checks—a bill with broad bipartisan public support.
**February 14, 2018**
That’s Parkland—a moment when public opinion on gun safety experienced its most significant shift since Sandy Hook. It was also the inspiration for a new generation of gun safety advocates and organizers who helped make future change possible.
**June 25, 2022**
That was the day President Joe Biden signed the first significant piece of federal legislation passed in almost three decades to make our communities safer from gun violence.
**November 8, 2022**
That’s Election Day. The day we’ll find out if we have elected a majority of members of Congress who will take further action on gun safety.
**But first... August 31, 2022**
That’s our next significant fundraising deadline. And when it ends, we’ll take stock of our budget and make some difficult spending decisions ahead of these critical midterm elections. These are decisions that can flip races and determine House and Senate majorities.

subject: Answers: Do I qualify for student loan forgiveness?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VERONICA ESCOBAR FOR CONGRESS
body:
I'm here to help you cancel your student loan debt

| |
---
Hi friend – as you may have heard, President Biden will provide student loan debt relief to borrowers. I wanted to reach out and let you know what that means for you and those you love with student loan debt.
* * *
**Do I qualify for student loan forgiveness, and will this impact me?** **You will be eligible to apply for loan forgiveness if you make under $125,000 annually or if your household income is under $250,000 annually.** It's estimated that 43 million borrowers will receive some form of student loan forgiveness. And 23 million people will have their loans forgiven entirely. **Roughly half of Latino borrowers will have their student loan debt forgiven entirely – that is huge in cities like El Paso.** **How much of my debt would be forgiven?** If you fit the economic criteria above, **up to $10,000 **in federal student loans will be forgiven. **Pell Grant recipients will receive up to $20,000 **in federal student loans forgiveness. It's important to note that your relief will be capped at your outstanding debt. Meaning if you have $7,000 in loans and qualify for the program, $7,000 will be forgiven because that’s the maximum you owe. **How do I get my loans forgiven?** Within the next few weeks, the White House will release an application to have your student loan debt forgiven. **This application must be filled out before December 31st, 2022.** **I heard people who work in public service could get their entire loans forgiven. Is that true?** If you have worked in public service (federal, state, local, tribal government or a non-profit organization) for 10 years or more (even if not consecutively), you may be eligible to have all your student debt canceled. Now, for a limited time, individuals can use past student loan payments to count toward student loan forgiveness, even if they have not yet served in public service for 10 years. [**To find out if you're eligible and apply for PSLF, click here. You must fill this out before October 31st, 2022 to receive credit for past payments.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49735669/363310165/-1125081753?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjc4MDNiOS1hOTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=n72-LMYUxqqBHEH70U75B9FvTwvkxI44pM0nQRqubeE=&emci=4b075000-a624-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f27803b9-a924-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=14565883) **Are there any other factors that I should know about in President Biden's proposal?** The federal government will cover the borrower's unpaid monthly interest, so that unlike other existing income-driven repayment plans,**no borrower's loan balance will grow as long as they make their monthly payments—even when that monthly payment is $0 because their income is low.** **Did President Biden extend the student loan repayment pause?** Yes, there has been a final extension of the **student loan repayment pause through December 31st, 2022**. The extended pause will occur automatically. Payments for student loans are expected to resume in January of 2023. **Where can I find more information?** Click here to learn more about what this means [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49735671/363310167/-2090096060?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjc4MDNiOS1hOTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=n72-LMYUxqqBHEH70U75B9FvTwvkxI44pM0nQRqubeE=&emci=4b075000-a624-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f27803b9-a924-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=14565883).
* * *
If you have any other questions or need clarification, please reply to this email and someone from my team will be in touch with you. I'm proud of President Biden for delivering for working-class Americans, and I look forward to seeing the impact this will have on millions of hardworking Americans. With you, Veronica

name: Jimmy Panetta
subject: My legislation to help prevent fires
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jimmy Panetta for Congress 2020, FEC ID# C00592154
body:
The threat of wildfires is one of the most pressing issues for the people of California.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49736396/363311832/-2113420158?refcode=JP_EM_PT_3MO_20220825_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZmIwNWVmNS1hYjI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ola9tX2RNJskctIeaH6iVB-yGPIjYYqR23Emik8mW34=&emci=89356623-b523-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=0fb05ef5-ab24-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6108787) | Peter,

The **threat of wildfires** is one of the most pressing issues for the people of California.

More than 4.6 million properties in our state — about 40% — have at least a moderate risk of burning in a wildfire in the next 30 years. That’s an astonishing number of people who could be left homeless, or much worse.

That’s why **I’ve authored, introduced, and passed legislation** that would **help reduce the threat of wildfires.**

I wrote and introduced the **Wildfire Emergency Act** that would provide a strategy and the authority to start thinning out the undergrowth of overgrown forests and then allow for closely monitored **prescribed burns** to eliminate the dead and dying trees.

I also wrote and introduced the **Save Our Forests Act** that would **address the chronic staffing shortages** in our national forests, including the Los Padres National Forest. Since more than 80% of wildfires are caused by humans, we need to make sure we have the staff required to supervise and manage our national forests and grasslands. These critical employees will protect our natural resources, reduce the risk of wildfires, and improve our overall land management.

I’m proud to tell you both of these bills recently passed out of the House of Representatives as they were included in the Wildfire Response and Drought Resiliency Act.

[However, this critical bill was passed by the House but still needs Senate approval. Will you join me in demanding that the Senate pass this bill as soon as possible?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49736397/363311833/307693213?refcode=JP_EM_PT_3MO_20220825_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZmIwNWVmNS1hYjI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ola9tX2RNJskctIeaH6iVB-yGPIjYYqR23Emik8mW34=&emci=89356623-b523-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=0fb05ef5-ab24-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6108787)

In addition to the above bills, earlier this year, my legislation, **the REPLANT Act** , was signed into law authorizing the U.S. Forest Service to invest more than $100 million in **reforestation in our national forests.** It’s an historic investment that will help reduce the impacts of climate change, bolster our watersheds, and prevent landslides in the aftermath of devastating wildfires and strengthen America’s forestland.

[We must do more to prevent wildfires.

If you agree, please take a minute to sign our petition and demand immediate action from Congress on these crucial bills.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49736398/363311834/307693213?refcode=JP_EM_PT_3MO_20220825_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZmIwNWVmNS1hYjI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ola9tX2RNJskctIeaH6iVB-yGPIjYYqR23Emik8mW34=&emci=89356623-b523-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=0fb05ef5-ab24-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6108787)

Thanks for your support,

Jimmy

Greg Abbott’s dangerous law bans abortions beginning at conception. It has
no exception for rape or incest. And a full 82% of Texans oppose it.

women.

We must act now to defeat him and to restore the freedom of Texas women to

Texans of every political background — Democrats, Republicans,

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: re: my decision
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
I have a rare moment of free time this morning, and I’ve always found unscheduled time to be the best time to reflect.
#

I have a rare moment of free time this morning, and I’ve always found unscheduled time to be the best time to reflect. As I was thinking about how much grassroots supporters like you have done for our campaign, I thought I should reach out to you directly to tell you why I decided to run for Senate and why your support is so important to our success.
As Chief Justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court, I saw up close how justice was too often out of reach for people. I saw the ways laws handed down by Washington leave our families behind and how the wealthy and well-connected use our broken status quo to get ahead.
The truth is Washington has failed to deliver for our families, and I knew this race was a real opportunity for North Carolinians to have a change. We need a leader in the Senate who will break through the division and gridlock to stand up for the people.
Despite winning statewide twice, I knew this race would be unlike any challenge I’d taken on before. These Senate races are just so big and expensive — and honestly, they can get nasty. I knew I’d have to lean on more folks than I ever have before for support to pull this off — especially when we’re trying to do it the right way by rejecting corporate PAC money.
Honestly, I wish what we’d already raised would be enough because I hate to ask for money. But outside groups have already spent $8 million on behalf of my opponent before a single vote has been cast, and we know there are tens of millions of dollars more headed our way.
It takes an enormous amount of resources to run a campaign that can organize and speak to the hopes and needs of voters from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike. But that is what it is going to take to win, so with an important fundraising deadline just days away, I need to ask:
[**Can you please contribute $3 to our campaign before our end-of-month deadline to help us flip North Carolina’s Senate seat? The only way we can secure the real change Washington has failed to deliver is if we are in this fight together.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220825-1-MA&t=1&akid=1544%2E357359%2ERMCfvg)

You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty-like our free online courses. _ _ And though we're best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author-C.S. Lewis.In fact, our free online course, **"[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](http://trk.readactnews.)" **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That's why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **"[An Introduction to C.S. Today, millions of women in Tennessee have been stripped of their right to privacy and their reproductive rights. As a physician, I can definitively say that healthcare providers are also being criminalized for doing their jobs to protect and save lives.
After being elected the Governor of Tennessee, I will work to repeal this awful trigger law and use every possible mechanism of the office to make sure women have full access to healthcare. Until this trigger law is repealed, we need to make sure that any legislation we pass includes coverage for transportation, protections against prosecution, increased counseling services, and a renewed focus on the people affected most - women.
Let me be clear, I will not hesitate to use the pardoning power of the office to make sure that no health care provider is prosecuted for providing the best health care possible.
If the radical super majority in the General Assembly decides to prosecute women, as has been brought up by people here in Tennessee and in other states, I will make sure that those women are pardoned if prosecutors choose to attack our citizens in their time of need.

body:
| | | |
---
| Dear Friends,
Congratulations! We did it!
The Fair and Secure MA Committee announced today that about 100,000 people signed the petition to repeal legislation giving driver's licenses to illegal immigrants - almost twice the number needed.
After I called for this ballot question a few months ago, volunteers from the Diehl and Allen campaigns were vital in collecting tens of thousands of these signatures over the past few weeks. Without you and all we did together, this would not have happened.
---
---
Leah and I would like to thank you for all of your hard work.
No matter how hot it was sitting outside shopping malls, and no matter how hard those on the left tried to push back, you were there. You were there this year just like you were there back in 2014 when we fought to repeal inflationary gas tax increases. We collected 100,000 signatures for that question back then, and it passed at the ballot box. I am confident that we will have the same result this November.
It is vitally important that we see the process through until the end. We will be working hard to get the word out to more voters over the next few weeks, reminding them how important it is to vote.
That process starts in just a few days, with the Republican Primary on September 6. I respectfully ask you to please remember to get out and vote for Leah Allen and for me.
Today is cause for celebration, and for gratitude. Thank you for all you've done so far, and all you intend to do going forward.
Tell all your friends to get on-board and join us. We're going to win this. (Just don't tell the liberal elites; let them all be shocked when they find out on November 8!)
Sincerely,
---

name: Chrissy
subject: 10 things about me 👋
body:
I know there are a lot of new folks who just joined our team – so I wanted to introduce myself.

---
| |
---
Derek,

I've been traveling across PA-06, speaking with our community members, and have had the opportunity to reconnect with familiar faces and have been introduced to new ones as well. I know there are a lot of new folks who just joined our team – so I wanted to introduce myself.
**I'm excited to share with you 10 things you might not yet know about me:**
1. My father came to the United States as a refugee fleeing war-torn Poland during WWII. A generation later, I am able to serve in Congress. I am here because the United States welcomed refugees and gave me a chance at the American dream.
2. His experience led me to want to serve – I knew that I wanted to give back to my community and the country that has given my family and me so much. So I served in the Air Force and as a Teach for America Teacher. This spirit of service has remained pivotal in my work for the past three years as your representative in Washington.
3. My experiences have helped shape my political vision of ensuring no one is left behind. I am committed to fighting for access to quality, affordable health care and working to build a robust economy for everyone.
4. As a former teacher, I know how difficult and important this critical job is, even in the best of times. That’s why I have and will continue to push for legislation that strengthens our schools, protects the rights of our teachers, and provides the best learning environment for our kids.
5. Our district is home to multiple semiconductor companies. As an entrepreneur, I know that fixing our supply chains was critical. So I helped pass the CHIPS and Science Act, which will bring more manufacturing jobs to Pennsylvania, and will get more goods on our shelves more quickly.
6. I worked with Republicans and Democrats to invest in our infrastructure because it's important that our community has the resources to succeed. As a result, Pennsylvania will receive $18 billion in federal funding to fix our roads, bridges, public transportation, pipes, and broadband.
7. As a mother, I will always advocate for Pennsylvania families. I've led the bipartisan effort to extend paid parental leave for millions of Americans, and I will continue to ensure that all families can have secure, affordable child care and improve childhood literacy.
8. I am pro choice – and I am happy that the House passed the Women's Health Protection Act, and that the Senate introduced the Freedom to Travel for Health Care Act. But I know that the fight is far from over, and I will continue to fight to protect women’s reproductive rights.
9. I've led efforts to lower costs on gas and everyday goods, helping to pass the Inflation Reduction Act. This is a major triumph for both our economy and our environment. I am proud to have voted to reduce health care and utility costs, combat climate change, and strengthen our economy.
10. Lastly, during the 116th Congress, I was honored to have been a recipient of the Abraham Lincoln Leadership for America Award. The U.S. Chamber of Commerce presents this award to TOP Senators and Representatives for supporting legislation that is important to the business community and the free enterprise system.
As a longtime resident of Southeastern Pennsylvania, I am dedicated to solving real problems for the people and communities of Pennsylvania. But as I face the GOP, that is coming after me as its TOP target for defeat, I need your help more than ever. This campaign relies on grassroots supporters like you to help us keep up our momentum. [**Derek, please help me win this race by chipping in today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49738237/363320551/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk662-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDAzOGIzMy1iMTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PU-rzlkNobWei995lo_xkjDpvWm6cE-Osyowopncmts=)
It's an honor to serve you. Thank you.

There's work to be done,

Chrissy

My father came to the United States as a refugee fleeing war-torn Poland during WWII. A generation later, I am able to serve in Congress. I am here because the United States welcomed refugees and gave me a chance at the American dream. 2. His experience led me to want to serve – I knew that I wanted to give back to my community and the country that has given my family and me so much. So I served in the Air Force and as a Teach for America Teacher. This spirit of service has remained pivotal in my work for the past three years as your representative in Washington. 3. My experiences have helped shape my political vision of ensuring no one is left behind. I am committed to fighting for access to quality, affordable health care and working to build a robust economy for everyone. 4. As a former teacher, I know how difficult and important this critical job is, even in the best of times. That’s why I have and will continue to push for legislation that strengthens our schools, protects the rights of our teachers, and provides the best learning environment for our kids. 5. Our district is home to multiple semiconductor companies. As an entrepreneur, I know that fixing our supply chains was critical. So I helped pass the CHIPS and Science Act, which will bring more manufacturing jobs to Pennsylvania, and will get more goods on our shelves more quickly. 6. I worked with Republicans and Democrats to invest in our infrastructure because it's important that our community has the resources to succeed. As a result, Pennsylvania will receive $18 billion in federal funding to fix our roads, bridges, public transportation, pipes, and broadband. 7. I've led the bipartisan effort to extend paid parental leave for millions of Americans, and I will continue to ensure that all families can have secure, affordable child care and improve childhood literacy. 8. When I was appointed to serve as California’s first Latino Senator, Rep. Karen Bass was one of the first people to congratulate me. She commended me for ‘shattering another glass ceiling’ following then-Senator Harris’s historic election.

Today, I’m honored to put my support behind a friend, colleague, and fellow Angeleno who is set to break _another_ barrier. Los Angeles needs Karen to win this race. [**I hope you’ll join me in supporting her by chipping in to her campaign. We need to work together to make sure Karen can secure a win this November.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49738639/363322808/-592683541?ms=em22_220825_Endrs_fndd_gq_act___SAP_ettx&refcode=em22_220825_Endrs_fndd_gq_act___SAP_ettx&source=em22_220825_Endrs_fndd_gq_act___SAP_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220825_Endrs_fndd_gq_act___SAP_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=vjN8WNY48%2BmeXx9XU0STdcSgeCPrLNQmZu%2FrU5Hc14%2BpsCwbFpN8PO53iOAsldoddCZxxb8isYMQ1S2oDZQH4sV4qQOVvFPzkdZMnOKBAdkWw%2B3JVo7hnFYmczQPUFDkC%2FyM3gxRbqzlBmNJ0em1PQ%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZmY0OTA5My1iMjI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AJ-_gfLZeinwshw0WzuWmvRxFtWZBsi5eSY6HevNo40=&emci=92ae1461-9024-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=0ff49093-b224-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)

I've seen firsthand that Karen is an effective and focused natural-born leader. She has a history of delivering tangible results in Washington _and_ the California State legislature.

In Sacramento, Karen served as the first Black woman to lead any State Legislature in the nation. As speaker, she led California through the most challenging recession since the Great Depression and onto economic recovery.

Her leadership has helped improve the lives of countless vulnerable individuals. Karen passed legislation to help foster care youth, protect 600,000 children from losing health care, fortify our state’s infrastructure, and so much more.

Karen has what it takes to lead and get the job done for Los Angeles. She understands the city’s numerous crises and has the vision and experience to create lasting change.

Her track record speaks for itself, but she is up against a real challenge this November. Her opponent has unlimited funds to pump into the race, so she needs your support. clean_body: Karen is the best bet to lead Los Angeles forward. Hello there, When I was appointed to serve as California’s first Latino Senator, Rep. Karen Bass was one of the first people to congratulate me. She commended me for ‘shattering another glass ceiling’ following then-Senator Harris’s historic election. Today, I’m honored to put my support behind a friend, colleague, and fellow Angeleno who is set to break another barrier. Los Angeles needs Karen to win this race. I've seen firsthand that Karen is an effective and focused natural-born leader. She has a history of delivering tangible results in Washington and the California State legislature. In Sacramento, Karen served as the first Black woman to lead any State Legislature in the nation. As speaker, she led California through the most challenging recession since the Great Depression and onto economic recovery. Her leadership has helped improve the lives of countless vulnerable individuals. Karen passed legislation to help foster care youth, protect 600,000 children from losing health care, fortify our state’s infrastructure, and so much more. Karen has what it takes to lead and get the job done for Los Angeles. She understands the city’s numerous crises and has the vision and experience to create lasting change. Her track record speaks for itself, but she is up against a real challenge this November. Her opponent has unlimited funds to pump into the race, so she needs your support. I can’t think of a better person to be the next Mayor of Los Angeles. Thanks for your time. | Fellow activist,

As Pennsylvania youth return to school, it’s crucial we keep their civic engagement and education in mind — because right now, we’re failing them.

Only 1 in 4 of the Commonwealth’s high school students who are eligible to vote are actually registered. That’s the statewide average. But when you look at the areas surrounding Allegheny and Philadelphia counties, that number is down to less than 15%. Areas such as East Allegheny, McKeesport, and the City of Chester are **under 7% registration rates for high school students who are eligible to vote.**

Low youth participation is **disastrous** for our democracy and young people alike. And this is why centering and empowering young constituents is one of the New Pennsylvania Project’s top priorities. Not every high school student goes on to college. We must engage students in grade school to ensure they make their voices heard at the ballot box.

Friend,
Florida Democrats nominated my opponent and it's more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I've worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. __**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=cb7d29289e564a01a9941e6796989dfb&_e=d2G38ZS8PURZU_hLlCpm65QsPIO5BMEq5SZbZc8rlA2TA9q27Vfl9adWcEDIHB9Z_P1O8D6bmHDp_QyRtqnHVtPVBwmVxeP2sGLNWY61V2nDHCO4-kqg_xGeRmqXlRYxTJC1WK1jT-iplJqAy6cuc3E6qLobTVLFqS7US0cSXK6rJDNVtjQzdtWimGpnPLGdL3WjQbb1VDcYKl9MYZrafJDzFySmqTlMUvu3H9nkEqYJe6hYUwzTq8UZZ4ZYo76F1VAtc40BABaXzXg64rlh4enIfetwn8LcwnJ7CzSe5XLlFSjQUrvvCusLcVq1tfBqSeIT58GCj66grGhapVPByg%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a823e7f923b4e189ce24f81919f34ad5e6e0e93c92f5af7be0bc4983968cedf67d6c59153b69b03932da62f205646544164")**__

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that's what this fight is all about. __**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=cb7d29289e564a01a9941e6796989dfb&_e=d2G38ZS8PURZU_hLlCpm65QsPIO5BMEq5SZbZc8rlA2TA9q27Vfl9adWcEDIHB9Z_P1O8D6bmHDp_QyRtqnHVtPVBwmVxeP2sGLNWY61V2nDHCO4-kqg_xGeRmqXlRYxTJC1WK1jT-iplJqAy6cuc3E6qLobTVLFqS7US0cSXK6rJDNVtjQzdtWimGpnPLGdfswAAWX3Pd2aq7yqqQAae5jsCg8T-wApYIIsVQ0Cu_vY9o-CYH7a5-5LlZrV92j_vWnNJUq-go9MAWsEi8G7ZOx3wpUzhNUG0Rbux0ldE7f5atGMWZ4BMsQHX_XIK7UejkZqVFJGtDn0oFBDj693kA%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a82b8a6f1a3d03523b43db6b553c5bda68e4f30d6b509c8b9925547b24af2737a9c0b13eb8b3e770ac8cd6a5aceb624ac59")**__

**It 's not about me, it's not about my opponent, it's about you - your business, your children's education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in its approach against the Left's radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers' unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist - you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I've only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. __**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=cb7d29289e564a01a9941e6796989dfb&_e=d2G38ZS8PURZU_hLlCpm65QsPIO5BMEq5SZbZc8rlA2TA9q27Vfl9adWcEDIHB9Z_P1O8D6bmHDp_QyRtqnHVtPVBwmVxeP2sGLNWY61V2nDHCO4-kqg_xGeRmqXlRYxTJC1WK1jT-iplJqAy6cuc3E6qLobTVLFqS7US0cSXK6rJDNVtjQzdtWimGpnPLGdCHheBR1-iNZD3lkD5sS0uGN2y63jX2fFA4MCFxCZD-MpQqGBs8N695c1-98mgWEIDw5B2ZXf-NVTTnM5fOke3Gv-DwuAur368hgenpoX-KHb5xgNRfOsP3TFlbZ43MVbqhIGnh15hhudC-KsIuUEkQ%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a82ee90298480be1e70765f6d70f433b61f6562e3959ac8e03699ca3c1635e3a9cd7bf91b5e578c157e822512f9b87bfa44")**__

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business's ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and __**[stand with me in the fight against the Left's schemes and radical agenda. >>>>](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=cb7d29289e564a01a9941e6796989dfb&_e=d2G38ZS8PURZU_hLlCpm65QsPIO5BMEq5SZbZc8rlA2TA9q27Vfl9adWcEDIHB9Z_P1O8D6bmHDp_QyRtqnHVtPVBwmVxeP2sGLNWY61V2nDHCO4-kqg_xGeRmqXlRYxTJC1WK1jT-iplJqAy6cuc3E6qLobTVLFqS7US0cSXK6rJDNVtjQzdtWimGpnPLGdabe8mwqGiC87uxs43Cy0GMe5q2AgxBww2tk05fqlkczjXOPLs6YX3ST13fHhgWM5x_1Y0j5c07Uh8mCvDMIvmB2FCgCxJoyjlV14GkE2DrwIqHJINo08BwkU5QMXmcDpFrrsNq03Q0OxDFpjj3HOBA%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a8281d926e974d43f54e1d1324cb0ec966cfe75389e7af10ce2c461b39aa31ec833dffbccf3a22fe2f24f49114ac33b18a0")**__
Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DIEHL FOR MASSACHUSETTS
body:
| | | | Shocking and Disturbing New Video Exposes Chris Doughty's Company for a Lengthy History of Terrible Air and Noise Pollution
BOSTON, Mass. -- A shocking and disturbing new video released today has exposed Capstan Atlantic, Inc., run by self-funded gubernatorial candidate Chris Doughty, for a lengthy history of environmental pollution in the Wrentham, Massachusetts neighborhood where it's located and poor treatment of the company's neighbors.
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Z_sgsz_z_6hizsiqFy-W31Q97cb2RydvSXei1Ct4yrKqG_r1RicEh_niQn3HTDxrRHZacEd_r1I7YKJiiUB2mz1DwIqUTO_cj9wLkmvSBXwdH6GvBwuqZoLMJvaHCETyNzIK1qFGVD_PsVPYP8hhvQ==&c=KdKL6zfnAIU8r8JxKfWWGrtfTib7Vni-wCjCmKWGtM-f_YyhL1J0jQ==&ch=6DXqggXSk8o9O-8kY05Lh819L9wBqkPXRhYGWP-aoFZoSWJ5wCUF6g==)
---
---
| In the video, Tim and Lynette O'Connell, whose home abuts Doughty's company, detail a long history of air pollution and loud noise produced by the company. The pollution, they claim, is so bad that they have had to wash residue off the side of their home. They also claim the noise is excessive.
The O'Connells claim they brought these issues to the attention of Chris Doughty repeatedly in the past, to no avail. "Nobody cares," they say of Doughty and Capstan's management.
In the video, the O'Connells claim the issue is relevant in the race for Governor, where Chris Doughty is relying on his experience as a CEO for credibility because of his lack of a political record. "How can you trust somebody that can't run their own business to run the state of Massachusetts?" They further admonish Doughty for having wrongfully claimed federal assistance during the pandemic and now using that money to self-fund his gubernatorial campaign, without having addressed pollution issues at the company.
Capstan Atlantic has been the subject of environmental fines in the past, [as reported several months ago in the Sun Chronicle](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Z_sgsz_z_6hizsiqFy-W31Q97cb2RydvSXei1Ct4yrKqG_r1RicEh4Y59FZmMulVl5rpiH3iC6F2iBJefmsb1iGyiWi1cwpbk-T4KNiKTXvwKOyLHiZmk5AcZVfwlYTeWL2y9UZebMsmDNRynPPsk6e97HFnLPtUpiKRaxT7k0YkImBp8l7jKvk_PGgNIni1ShJS6KYEh5zFkzMYByaD-xPMrkVBVPUHYD_34sFC1XTVudRVdDEdSkh9IR4_sMqM2-KTaRKy7SauA4eLDfG5Tyu0gfs5GVlve0aUS3jWqwz_OPOgYqZNnjs4hvvCYmYWYUmB-rrUEFA2CQ5z8A8T69z3q0Zep809&c=KdKL6zfnAIU8r8JxKfWWGrtfTib7Vni-wCjCmKWGtM-f_YyhL1J0jQ==&ch=6DXqggXSk8o9O-8kY05Lh819L9wBqkPXRhYGWP-aoFZoSWJ5wCUF6g==).
"Voters need to know the full story behind the people they're voting for in the Republican Primary on September 6," Amanda Orlando, Campaign Manager for Diehl for MA, said. "We've known all along that Chris Doughty is not a credible Republican on the basis of his 2016 vote for Hillary Clinton for President. Now, this damning video casts overwhelming doubt on Chris Doughty's credibility to lead the state on the basis of being the CEO of a local company." ###

_You see, where others talk,_**_Judicial Watch_** _acts_! _And with real impact_!

name: Alessandra Biaggi
subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress
body:
Although Tuesday's primary did not end the way we had hoped, I feel an immense amount of gratitude.
#

Friends,
Thank you so much for being a part of our campaign. Although Tuesday's primary did not end the way we had hoped, I feel an immense amount of gratitude.
In just 90 days, we built a people-powered campaign that fought to end big money polluting our politics, to elevate the grassroots over the wallets of special interests, and to create a government that delivers for working people, not corporate donors.
Dark money super PACs spent nearly $1 million against us because when we're brave enough to tell the truth about systems that need to change, people in power feel threatened.
The NYC PBA spent hundreds of thousands of dollars against me because I come from a law enforcement family — my grandfather was one of the most decorated police officers in NYPD history, and that makes me a credible messenger for police reform and accountability.
I ran this longshot race to make the Democratic Party better. That is transformational work, and it takes time and sustained conviction.
We **_will_** see the day that the Democratic Party once again puts working people and the middle class first. That is what Americans deserve, and it’s what will win general elections.
We would be a better party if more Democratic leaders took personal career risk, instead of always protecting their own existing power. And while it isn’t fun to lose a race, I will _always_ take a stand for what is right, rather than get complacent with my power.
I’ve failed a lot more often than I’ve won in my life, and it’s always been the failures that have fueled the future wins. But right now, this contest is over, and we must prevent a Republican majority in the House — that includes defending NY-17 with everything we've got.
After some much-needed rest, you will see me out on the frontlines working to keep this district in Democratic hands, and I hope I can count on you and our movement to join me in that fight.
Thank you to the hundreds of volunteers who tirelessly made tens of thousands of phone calls and knocked on countless doors spreading our message of bold, progressive change to voters in every corner of the district.
Thank you to the thousands of donors from across the country who made our grassroots campaign possible by chipping in $5, $25, and $50 at a time.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you so much to every single supporter that joined us in the fight for a more equitable future.
It is our relentlessness that will make everything we've worked for possible. I look forward to joining you in the fights ahead.
With gratitude,
Alessandra

I’m on the ground with Florida grassroots patriots working tirelessly to take back the House, and we need your help.| | | Peter, I’m on the ground with Florida grassroots patriots working tirelessly to take back the House, and we need your help.

Bolduc continues to push the Big Lie and baseless election fraud claims and even “promised to defy the presidential election results, should he be called upon to do so in 2024." And that’s not all—Bolduc says he is open to abolishing the FBI and even recently called to repeal the 17th Amendment, which allows voters to elect their Senators directly. Don Bolduc's dangerous rhetoric couldn't be more out of touch with Granite State values, and if elected, he would only drag New Hampshire backward. With everything from reproductive rights (Bolduc said we should “rejoice” at _Roe_ being overturned) to the fate of our planet (he said climate is “not a priority”) on the line, we cannot afford to have Don Bolduc in the United States Senate. clean_body: This isn't just bad news for our Senate majority – it's bad for our democracy. | | | = | | = This is alarming, Derek: Don Bolduc, a far-right extremist running against me, is leading the polls in New Hampshire. And that’s not all—Bolduc says he is open to abolishing the FBI and even recently called to repeal the 17th Amendment, which allows voters to elect their Senators directly. Don Bolduc's dangerous rhetoric couldn't be more out of touch with Granite State values, and if elected, he would only drag New Hampshire backward. With everything from reproductive rights (Bolduc said we should “rejoice” at Roe being overturned) to the fate of our planet (he said climate is “not a priority”) on the line, we cannot afford to have Don Bolduc in the United States Senate. ---
[](http://links.votemichelsforgov.com/u/click?_t=41b24d3b5b56407d9b83bd257723f463&_m=412a4c2fffd34a4d8427d3f2ed746d08&_e=lkYLI0OlGwIkpNaHFSoSK5iHlSK7xsjQjFPPOvPpZnXly_tC6-vBv-CYmgHiSpQ_F2Ip2vsV_ibTARV_VAjN3Br00YwPX9CjbWeBBom3OLWOU9zj8F5ZmDihYEoGe9e-8xGD5c0dCJt6qACk3GCaV9fYes1GJ3jBk4bgFtXBmRMjIdYgXiBwXa3_dJ4hwrURSH94znYO_yOCU-x1TEQWFhK1_IgLuiZRHaSwWYnsapg%3D)

subject: Thank you. Now, Let's Keep Fighting,
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Peggy Schiller
body:
The election didn't go the way I wanted, but I'm incredibly grateful for your support. Now, it's time to keep fighting for the 1st District. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ac66000ae01a/your-vote-is-your-voice-make-sure-you-are-heard-9057994?e=9c22e4067b)
---
| |
---
| | Hello Peter,

I've taken a day to reflect on the results of the primary election. Although things didn't turn out as we would have hoped, I have so much to be thankful for and have internalized many valuable lessons learned.

**THANK YOU** to everyone who supported me, voted for me, donated to my campaign, sent texts, made phone calls, knocked on doors, gathered petitions, put signs in yards, and simply told others about my candidacy. There are not enough words to express how deeply thankful I am for every ounce of your kindness and support.

While this may be the end of my candidacy for Congressional office, there is still a great deal of work to do. I may take some time to remember what a full night's sleep is, to have dinners with my family, and to binge on the best shows that I've missed over the past 8 months,**but then it's time to get back to work.**

The **LESSONS** **LEARNED** from the campaign trail will fuel my next chapter:
1. **Not Enough People Vote:** with a turnout of just 26% in our district, **we need to reach more voters and help them realize that their vote is their voice and that it can be so powerful.**
2. **Campaigning is Rough:** I commend anyone who puts themselves out there to run for office. I never imagined the lies and threats that would be cast in my direction from both left and right of the aisle. **Remaining true to my morals and values was the only way to overcome the negativity and misinformation.**
3. **Fundraising is a Necessary Evil:** **consider giving to the candidates you believe in.** They literally cannot do it without a constant stream of funding coming into the campaign.
4. **People are Kind-Hearted: **we are diverse in so many ways, but there are always commonalities to find. **I was honored to meet so many wonderful people who were passionate about the issues that plagued their lives.** People shared stories, marched in protest, asked tough questions, and offered words of advice out of the goodness of their hearts.
5. **Our Future is Bright:** we may live in the reddest district in the state, but the **Democratic presence continues to gain momentum and will be here for the long haul.** Continue fighting for causes that motivate you, support candidates who will fight for you, donate your time and resources, and **never stop believing that the blue wave is smoldering and building with every cycle. **

I may not know exactly what is next for me, but I will remain active in the Democratic Party supporting the causes that I believe in. The challenges that face us grow every day. **Now is the time to fight!**

We have an important election coming up in November. The stakes are high. Be sure to get involved and make a difference.

Thanks,
---
|
---
| P.S. Our [**store**](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=79f10186b5&e=9c22e4067b) is still open if you'd like to grab any Beat Matt Gaetz items or campaign momentos. body:
