Peter,
Florida Democrats nominated my opponent and it's more of the same from the lockdown Left.

Since being elected, I've worked each and every day towards bettering the lives of all who call the Sunshine State home. My goal is, and always will be, to leave Florida to God better than we started with. __**[Stand with me to protect our state.>>>>](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=242c66255023410d939bad489725c06b&_e=rFutxzYD2lHBGIMs8LRHKNar5x0NeC2iVRqu6htp2KWx8_svVvrsmVymZ8rJUvYx3rCesYawfPLnmUabjre_lh2oSZ7p6aRVgNvDUersfa73vBUmgoUnAuZnTyaKCXdGkhTfLoPMQyOpGsafUCiw5MJes_q83n_CmyiDslnlmk-Abz6hAX9rcGfooM9U5oy2jOJuiCSp19mdXihrlQ8zVFAjrfKgSOZg31s_5CR8PqMwdVidNL4tdz8k0Z7y_mHTcwv7mvqj9smdSyIEogryVErPNInRfbz1KDBivfVFiy-Ht8HPgpj9-CIZFUBGNnF5wvJqHsqxlPDuby5II8d1ig%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a823e7f923b4e189ce24f81919f34ad5e6e0e93c92f5af7be0bc4983968cedf67d6c59153b69b03932da62f205646544164")**__

As Governor, I lead based on the inherent truth that our rights come from God, not the government. That truth is the driving force behind all the work we have accomplished and all that we know is still to be done.

In Florida, we do not answer to the demands of the Liberal elite. We answer to the people of Florida. For me, that's what this fight is all about. __**[Join me in the fight to Keep Florida Free.>>>>](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=242c66255023410d939bad489725c06b&_e=rFutxzYD2lHBGIMs8LRHKNar5x0NeC2iVRqu6htp2KWx8_svVvrsmVymZ8rJUvYx3rCesYawfPLnmUabjre_lh2oSZ7p6aRVgNvDUersfa73vBUmgoUnAuZnTyaKCXdGkhTfLoPMQyOpGsafUCiw5MJes_q83n_CmyiDslnlmk-Abz6hAX9rcGfooM9U5oy2Mbzku11X4PUomzxXbJbgQaUjCMeHEc_QsW3WGupLN4szPGIpxMT6hPDKH5xLw_YDZVG_C3p_updem8Mm-mKgG8T_iquY1c8O7EqC4hKpP_FxxUkjDSj73W8bCsSutbvxDL5Ux2-Y-p8Mm1Szv-yO0g%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a82b8a6f1a3d03523b43db6b553c5bda68e4f30d6b509c8b9925547b24af2737a9c0b13eb8b3e770ac8cd6a5aceb624ac59")**__

**It 's not about me, it's not about my opponent, it's about you - your business, your children's education, and your personal liberties.**

Throughout my first term, we led the country in staying on the offense against the dangerous policies of the Biden regime. While other states waited and reacted, Florida was proactive in its approach against the Left's radical agenda, and Floridians are better off for it.

When Biden and his pocket puppet Fauci were hellbent on locking children out of school, we kept our kids in the classroom. Unmasked. Five days a week.

When they targeted small businesses with crippling mandates and lockdowns, we remained open for business and gave Floridians the tools to make it out stronger on the other side.

When woke teachers' unions worked to inject radical and divisive material into our classrooms and keep information on students a secret from parents, we stepped in and made known that the purpose of Florida schools is to educate, not indoctrinate our children. When blue states allowed and encouraged crime and disorder to run rampant, we sent a strong message as a law-and-order state that in Florida, if you engage in violent or heinous crimes you will not get a slap on the wrist - you'll get the inside of a jail cell.

I've only just begun my fight to Keep Florida Free. To continue our Freedom Agenda, I need the help of supporters like you to step up to the plate and get in the game. __**[Rush in your support TODAY.>>>>](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=242c66255023410d939bad489725c06b&_e=rFutxzYD2lHBGIMs8LRHKNar5x0NeC2iVRqu6htp2KWx8_svVvrsmVymZ8rJUvYx3rCesYawfPLnmUabjre_lh2oSZ7p6aRVgNvDUersfa73vBUmgoUnAuZnTyaKCXdGkhTfLoPMQyOpGsafUCiw5MJes_q83n_CmyiDslnlmk-Abz6hAX9rcGfooM9U5oy2qjivz3Jbt-o44-5X9h9tgKCKY3yF5q___fbRMA0JnWb1cjv9wOo81ha5fMQ7uoF0C0oQY3FLu4ST7622gORu9ZmNazi8nlg3Q6wFBGMw8i6p2RK9DXHaPuypBGy1brxy7_1-xj7kstFLfTT9YfCftA%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a82ee90298480be1e70765f6d70f433b61f6562e3959ac8e03699ca3c1635e3a9cd7bf91b5e578c157e822512f9b87bfa44")**__

This November, there is more on the line than just the R or D behind the candidate's name. Freedom is on the line. Your livelihoods. Your children's chance at a quality education and normal childhood. Your business's ability to grow and prosper. The safety of your community. Living your day-to-day free of overarching mandates and lockdowns.

Now is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So, suit up. Put on the full armor of God and __**[stand with me in the fight against the Left's schemes and radical agenda. >>>>](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=242c66255023410d939bad489725c06b&_e=rFutxzYD2lHBGIMs8LRHKNar5x0NeC2iVRqu6htp2KWx8_svVvrsmVymZ8rJUvYx3rCesYawfPLnmUabjre_lh2oSZ7p6aRVgNvDUersfa73vBUmgoUnAuZnTyaKCXdGkhTfLoPMQyOpGsafUCiw5MJes_q83n_CmyiDslnlmk-Abz6hAX9rcGfooM9U5oy2M3-GBGyFEz1VROY9joi5hxIHNIpQty6vVhMn_kJOBunttpY4yu2EWsOb1dX3B8DH1isB-_2SgZl69hDKJbh8IKnhNdNoJJPSPl2lLH-j3mFPv1hhvOaEkQGF8ZtCkmDVUO_IQmNlGiwbqYGw8l7HPQ%3D%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=283191c1cd579a8281d926e974d43f54e1d1324cb0ec966cfe75389e7af10ce2c461b39aa31ec833dffbccf3a22fe2f24f49114ac33b18a0")**__

Ron DeSantis

name: Jon Kaiman
subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Kaiman for Congress |
body:
Dear Peter,

I would like to thank all of you who contributed to my campaign, volunteered your time, and voted for me. I very much appreciate your belief in me as a candidate and your confidence in me as a leader. We ran a good, honest, and honorable race focused on substance and experience. Unfortunately, we came up short behind the winner of the Democratic Party primary, Robert Zimmerman.

Robert is a longtime friend and I wish him success in the November election.

While I believed that my experience and perspective made me the best candidate to meet the challenges that we are facing as a nation, and is the very reason I put myself forward as a candidate, I do believe Robert Zimmerman will serve us well. I now ask that we all rally around him as our nominee for US Congress in the 3rd Congressional District.

Thank you to all who engaged with me and my campaign; at your door, on the phone and at events. Thank you for allowing me to present my candidacy to you. I am delighted to have met you directly or through my campaign. It was a privilege to serve in the roles that I have throughout my public career and it was an honor to have been chosen by so many as your candidate for United States Congress.

Sincerely,

Jon Kaiman

Griffin claimed that he was at the Capitol as a peaceful protester, but other witnesses reported seeing him repeatedly encouraging the insurrectionist’s antics.

body:
Now student debt is all of our debt, THANKS TO PRESIDENT JOE BIDEN. Whether you like it or not, you're now responsible for paying back the debt millio Exclusive invitation enclosed to join my club of top supporters from throughout the country. One big caveat - you have to join Friday before midnight.

| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=671c1961f4164f9d8c50ffb485ccba53&_e=DhRc1JMaHlmnMKA4oXTIfr6UOJsvwvmnVotOvqIGzTeYfhezhJGpCdPeouINjaeLPKNrdlX2cVQSV2u-Nxj55eyQw6VUObxATndob2eKVli6-bWf0PNddFhs4EwXQtjR5uO1WuIABFqym64UntY-Zep_EhT0-_h8XX3eGh1vZlsiHfqTp32ZE3xiQvreMWDLXijkJb6m3XdNLR2vZvA624cdx8O2NflxQDlwdIDLnWV7r23cOwWoNG4vpoFy_BziJRfU1-qg5eEMZO9XJV91nb5rydNFSdatP4WvHEKQ7VHHNwjbOD6ZPs1_cxLm2dJK)
---

Peter,

Did you hear the news? In a nod to his left-wing base, President Biden today announced that he was “ _**cancelling**_ ” student loan debt for a group of mostly younger Americans.

You read that right. Student takes a loan ... student benefits from the loan ... but when it comes time for student to pay back the money they borrowed, **the President decides that their debt is cancelled**.

But think about it for a moment: _**Can student debt really be “cancelled” like that?**_ Does the debt just “**go away** ”, as the name suggests? **It doesn’t take an economics major to tell you the answer is “No!”.**

**[I want to know where you stand personally on student debt forgiveness.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=671c1961f4164f9d8c50ffb485ccba53&_e=DhRc1JMaHlmnMKA4oXTIfr6UOJsvwvmnVotOvqIGzTeYfhezhJGpCdPeouINjaeLPKNrdlX2cVQSV2u-Nxj55eyQw6VUObxATndob2eKVli6-bWf0PNddFhs4EwXQtjR5uO1WuIABFqym64UntY-Zep_EhT0-_h8XX3eGh1vZlsqYlkAgEpxNSn81bmKu4tczUQ5MvFOwf6vFZCGcu6mYnQpBOzi9TbqdZ45zDJTtNpUmiUoizZgdLA7xAUF10XlxA_liHBxoWJxyKxFRkPyRx6GoiH-zgalmBQK_8baqSGierr6_r2J3loEzPhBUVLA)** Do you support it, or do you believe, like I do, that cancelling student loan debt is the wrong policy?

[** DO YOU AGREE
WITH BIDEN'S DEBT CANCELLATION? **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=671c1961f4164f9d8c50ffb485ccba53&_e=DhRc1JMaHlmnMKA4oXTIfr6UOJsvwvmnVotOvqIGzTeYfhezhJGpCdPeouINjaeLPKNrdlX2cVQSV2u-Nxj55eyQw6VUObxATndob2eKVli6-bWf0PNddFhs4EwXQtjR5uO1WuIABFqym64UntY-Zep_EhT0-_h8XX3eGh1vZltiFekwvWtbMkRJ98lIgPXwJGv_W0LKa82MSzFuMUZ403L36mXndq7hzLurd9vy5PFi7jZmZlaZYUIB0YQIpg_WCO4_cIzi2juR2FmJB6TX_SoJ4XCcp3ugiaxRsfFzfN9hhKfFMRJjZjukT8VJ-17A)

Every dollar that’s borrowed must be paid back. But what Biden announced today is that these loans won’t be paid back by the people who took the loans. **Rather, they’ll be paid back by taxpayers like us!**

**Just to appease his most socialist supporters on the left, and in an attempt to energize younger voters before what is shaping up to be a difficult election for Democrats, Biden just launched a quarter-trillion-dollar tax and spend program that promotes fiscal irresponsibility and unfair treatment of those who took out students loans and paid them back.**

**[I really want to know where you stand on this issue – so please do me a favor and take my quick 3 question survey today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=671c1961f4164f9d8c50ffb485ccba53&_e=DhRc1JMaHlmnMKA4oXTIfr6UOJsvwvmnVotOvqIGzTeYfhezhJGpCdPeouINjaeLPKNrdlX2cVQSV2u-Nxj55eyQw6VUObxATndob2eKVli6-bWf0PNddFhs4EwXQtjR5uO1WuIABFqym64UntY-Zep_EhT0-_h8XX3eGh1vZlt0iN8qINU_PA7zAzb2cLRka-5E60cPivD4DGktizzD-0wtJmZg6X1-J_bt5Pr7PKEvyGe08EJ6Fw5Bs2m_U72gfrwrBwLVh9OSf9sgDHgnFnYnWzUUTW9kM42TW0P66qhiDb5Uc6JXEgVZDQjN-wYU)**

For Liberty,
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=671c1961f4164f9d8c50ffb485ccba53&_e=DhRc1JMaHlmnMKA4oXTIfr6UOJsvwvmnVotOvqIGzTeYfhezhJGpCdPeouINjaeLPKNrdlX2cVQSV2u-Nxj55eyQw6VUObxATndob2eKVli6-bWf0PNddFhs4EwXQtjR5uO1WuIABFqym64UntY-Zep_EhT0-_h8XX3eGh1vZlsT8uC4IxHaygFlgWb9x-A6-smK0BFaT8c0Tu0uwXObelw9PZV2NEdF8pIH_NLTspXjXYShLj9n3ZDY9BizFO3blA2adlEGqP9TQxv9u1VxJDmURFGO8harQQ0VnWJmdUO2Fry3ItuLGNiX_f5a_OFh)

body:
| | |
---
Peter, it's Alex, Trudy's campaign manager. **People ask me all the time if we can really win this race, if we can actually flip Missouri blue. And I always tell them the same thing: "Yes, but not alone." **
This seat is absolutely winnable, but we need the help of folks like you to pull this thing off.** That's why I'm asking: Can you chip in $5, or any amount, before 11:59 p.m. so that we can hit our $10,000 goal tonight and send Trudy to Washington? Here's the best link to give: [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/tbv-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49747876/363341015/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk243-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjFkZDFmNC1jMTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kFLjHbzIUwiiHOzST62EU-NLW1ceYOGbwSR4HyAklwI=)**
As one of our top supporters, I want you to hear directly from me why I believe Trudy can – and will – win in November.
Our opponent, Eric Schmitt is just plain wrong for Missouri. **He's a career politician being propped up by right-wing, anti-choice megadonors, and they're pushing radical ideas that don't match Missouri values.** Families here don't want another sell out extremist who only cares about his own ambition and radical ideology.
Just a few weeks ago, the entire country watched as Missouri's neighbors in Kansas rejected the GOP's radical, anti-abortion agenda. **The tide is shifting in the midwest and it's giving Trudy a clear path to victory.**
But more than trends and election data, I know that Trudy will win because I know Missouri and the incredible families who call our state home. I know our voters, our neighbors, and our communities. I know that we are capable of turning out the vote when it counts. **I know that we will reject hatred and division and choose kindness and compassion. Team,
I want to tell you a quick story about the difference between my campaign and Mike DeWine’s – and why **[I urgently need your help to win this race.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49733313/363301654/-1174581802?refcode=nw_em_220825_1_t2_a&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTBlNjIyMi1hMTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XaJRbKW_ONs1ka6JRXx8T7qaN8_8bUNO9SNhkCI7gaE=)**
I grew up in a union family. I’m the daughter of my dad who was an autoworker and my mom who worked at the laundromat behind our house to help make ends meet when my dad got laid off. I live in a pretty regular Ohio house – it’s where we filmed one of our ads. (This is my kitchen, featuring my dog, Louis!)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49733314/363301655/-1174581802?refcode=nw_em_220825_1_t2_a&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTBlNjIyMi1hMTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XaJRbKW_ONs1ka6JRXx8T7qaN8_8bUNO9SNhkCI7gaE=)
My opponent is a millionaire with a personal mansion – one that literally has its own Wikipedia page. He doesn't understand what it’s like to deal with rising costs and stagnant wages.
He’s not going to bed worried about how he’ll pay for groceries and rent or a mortgage. But he does have a slew of rich corporate friends bankrolling his campaign to rig the rules against working people.
These are the very same corporate friends he’s spent his years in office cozying up to, through corruption and pay-to-play schemes that have left Ohioans on the hook for billions of dollars in corporate bailouts. They’re not only out-of-touch with how most Ohioans are living, they’re expecting that Ohio taxpayers will foot the bill.
**We can change all that when we win this year –** new polling shows us in a virtual tie with Mike DeWine. But with outside spending coming in fast, we’re playing catch-up to ensure we have the resources to stay competitive.
**[Our campaign relies on those $5 and $10 and $25 donations from people like you who are ready to work together for change. Will you pitch in now so we can reach as many voters as possible about our vision for Ohio – one where all, not just the wealthy and well-connected, can succeed?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49733315/363301656/-1174581802?refcode=nw_em_220825_1_t2_a&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTBlNjIyMi1hMTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XaJRbKW_ONs1ka6JRXx8T7qaN8_8bUNO9SNhkCI7gaE=)**
Onward,
Nan

Fellow American,

I had hoped it wouldn't come to this, **but I'd prefer to be the one to tell you rather than let the Democrats leak the news to the mainstream media.**

As a result of the tough fundraising environment Republicans are seeing across the nation, **we're not raising enough money to run the campaign that we need to be running.** That means we've had to make some hard decisions. We made the toughest call we've had to make since last August.

We don't have enough money in the bank to keep our TV ads on air. As of last week, our ads are no longer running across Georgia.
**Meanwhile, our opponent Raphael Warnock has more cash than he knows what to do with.** He has more than $22 million in the bank and is raising MILLIONS MORE each WEEK. While our campaign doesn't have the money to keep our ads running, Raphael Warnock could run ads for the next 10 weeks __without raising another dollar.__

**I need your help. The more money we raise today, the sooner we can get back on the air.**

clean_body: We had to pull our ads off the air, so Raphael Warnock has the airwaves to himself in the race that will determine control of the Senate. | Fellow American, I had hoped it wouldn't come to this, but I'd prefer to be the one to tell you rather than let the Democrats leak the news to the mainstream media. That means we've had to make some hard decisions. We made the toughest call we've had to make since last August. We don't have enough money in the bank to keep our TV ads on air. What the Biden administration can do for Texans who need abortion care.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49754542/363343923/1120393829?refcode=em-wrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZjQ0M2M0Yi1jNTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lqe4_QJggP5GymAknpKdL7kzawsLP6xqgZ5Uu9EkSK8=&emci=71c61f55-b624-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=9f443c4b-c524-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6830379)
**Peter, today, Texas’ extreme abortion “trigger” ban went into effect.**
The law makes providing abortion a felony and increases penalties for abortion providers to $100,000+ and a sentence of up to life in prison.
**Texans need help now.** While some folks can travel out of state, most working class Texans cannot simply take multiple days off of work and travel hundreds of miles for abortion care. We must bring health care to them.
In July, our team led more than 50 Texas Democratic officials and abortion rights organizations in sending a letter to the Biden Administration, outlining steps we can take now to get Texans access to FDA-approved abortion medication inside state lines.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49754543/363343924/1535742500?refcode=em-20220825&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZjQ0M2M0Yi1jNTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lqe4_QJggP5GymAknpKdL7kzawsLP6xqgZ5Uu9EkSK8=)
**We are hopeful that the Biden Administration will step in to guarantee access to safe, in-state abortion by helping make sure you can see a health care provider, order abortion medication through the mail, and get it sent from another state into Texas.**
As your next Member of Congress, I will continue to fight for abortion access for all by increasing access to reproductive health care, repealing the Hyde Amendment, and codifying Roe v. Wade through the Women’s Health Protection Act.
[**We are only able to do this work because of your contributions. If you support winning back abortion rights in Texas, please chip in $5 or what you can today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49754544/363343925/1535742500?refcode=em-20220825&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZjQ0M2M0Yi1jNTI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lqe4_QJggP5GymAknpKdL7kzawsLP6xqgZ5Uu9EkSK8=)

Friend,
**Just two months ago, the Supreme Court’s conservative majority cruelly stripped away abortion rights, signaling that other fundamental rights are next on the chopping block. **
Once again, the bigotry of far-right justices threatens rights and privileges that the LGBTQ+ community, interracial couples, and families across the nation rely on. The Respect for Marriage Act is a step toward adding stability and certainty for these couples, children, and families.
**That’s why we need to stay in this fight.** To protect our freedom, future, and families we need our senators to safeguard our right to marry.
**[Tell your senators to lead with compassion and pass the Respect for Marriage Act.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49755905/363345592/170996563?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZGIzYmYyNi1jNjI0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WB6MiFegTlYnOXqDD31bv9W7bIFJLqjqPqKuxTKjZ6I=&emci=603311ea-f922-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=edb3bf26-c624-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172)**
**Here’s exactly how the Respect for Marriage Act protects our right to marry: **
* Repeals the antiquated Defense of Marriage Act (DOMA), which narrowly defined marriage and banned federal recognition of same-sex marriage
* Codifies marriage equality under federal law, protecting couples regardless of the state they were married in
* Secures additional legal protections, designating the authority to pursue enforcement actions, and creating a private right of action for any individual harmed by a violation of this provision

**The Senate is expected to vote on the Respect for Marriage Act any day now.** If our senators come forward with compassion and take this crucial step to protect the LGBTQ+ community, the bill’s next stop will be President Biden’s desk, where he will sign it into law.

clean_body: | | | Urge your senators to pass the Respect for Marriage Act and protect our right to marry who we love. | | | Friend, Just two months ago, the Supreme Court’s conservative majority cruelly stripped away abortion rights, signaling that other fundamental rights are next on the chopping block. Once again, the bigotry of far-right justices threatens rights and privileges that the LGBTQ+ community, interracial couples, and families across the nation rely on. The Respect for Marriage Act is a step toward adding stability and certainty for these couples, children, and families. That’s why we need to stay in this fight. To protect our freedom, future, and families we need our senators to safeguard our right to marry. Here’s exactly how the Respect for Marriage Act protects our right to marry: Repeals the antiquated Defense of Marriage Act (DOMA), which narrowly defined marriage and banned federal recognition of same-sex marriage Codifies marriage equality under federal law, protecting couples regardless of the state they were married in Secures additional legal protections, designating the authority to pursue enforcement actions, and creating a private right of action for any individual harmed by a violation of this provision The Senate is expected to vote on the Respect for Marriage Act any day now. If our senators come forward with compassion and take this crucial step to protect the LGBTQ+ community, the bill’s next stop will be President Biden’s desk, where he will sign it into law. The lives of people in the LGBTQ+ community (and beyond) have been politicized for far too long. It’s time to put people over politics and ensure that marriage equality remains the law of the land. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help, and it was even harder to get it. |
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c503f4fbb4264fee933ef0ade3139daa&_e=yOAZKLB8neQhJYU0nodctj4j3aMTEBA2cmmX37i1WYnmQjnwySW30qgBtHSPp24nSVzoHBXp5VzKAvSkrZOPfmGK5qZjGtbJqn6DchIkmYRuujY7CNMnjbWGRaUOg7SzkBDoska5QlLwamNzElzBJtkFx-9NTcyWosL0katDaXsrRHChI5IDeBeeflRhHMLAFuevRBgcr2WuMygrpdC_69J6No9qEyYa5OqBNTOJ4LoiwYOnVqxUBJyLhIyo4oyXu98X2EoUjK3HoPm-ohCHoWgbZMfuIWi1TpaorpFdC1ZCzYczlI704xOthHS20r6jSkVTMRA7t-duUCUQFi1oZrYPdiA7GbKxAnUUsiW8eZfSLmQs9WPBHG86ps9fLoKjPcWKfMerBaMTRZPcDyLJSn7inmLT1M0tlOWNJ1lLWkCZLi8C8HN4b-XolR9NoL8PuDdA36ooqVuqoCS55KA7mw%3D%3D)

Peter,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

But now that I'm running for office, **[my struggle has become the subject of a nasty and dishonest attack ad.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c503f4fbb4264fee933ef0ade3139daa&_e=yOAZKLB8neQhJYU0nodctj4j3aMTEBA2cmmX37i1WYnmQjnwySW30qgBtHSPp24nSVzoHBXp5VzKAvSkrZOPfmGK5qZjGtbJqn6DchIkmYRuujY7CNMnjbWGRaUOg7SzkBDoska5QlLwamNzElzBJtkFx-9NTcyWosL0katDaXsrRHChI5IDeBeeflRhHMLAFuevRBgcr2WuMygrpdC_69J6No9qEyYa5OqBNTOJ4LoiwYOnVqxUBJyLhIyo4oyXu98X2EoUjK3HoPm-ohCHoWgbZMfuIWi1TpaorpFdC1ZCzYczlI704xOthHS20r6jpu7y0ovgsWz6WSS-NOqEoVWt-ON-zFHwIVaPQwUZv-9BJxrmQ-dtM2CPCNih4-llBccVOMONyQ-JTM94DefXstvbaav6c69ki1Bz1KGRX_A7ayxZ7G7zKAIuXjoPorsPKjFAlvGqBObuml6xUIcYDA%3D%3D)** A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me.

The ad is titled **"The Real Herschel Walker,"** but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=c503f4fbb4264fee933ef0ade3139daa&_e=yOAZKLB8neQhJYU0nodctj4j3aMTEBA2cmmX37i1WYnmQjnwySW30qgBtHSPp24nSVzoHBXp5VzKAvSkrZOPfmGK5qZjGtbJqn6DchIkmYRuujY7CNMnjbWGRaUOg7SzkBDoska5QlLwamNzElzBJtkFx-9NTcyWosL0katDaXsrRHChI5IDeBeeflRhHMLAFuevRBgcr2WuMygrpdC_69J6No9qEyYa5OqBNTOJ4LoiwYOnVqxUBJyLhIyo4oyXu98X2EoUjK3HoPm-ohCHoWgbZMfuIWi1TpaorpFdC1ZCzYczlI704xOthHS20r6js6AehkCvaR63kawvKdm_WepO_1q-yvQ6xkvxmHldlphLY03Cc3ZAL8M_4snXLJJ85lM2njl1cUeaGAJ_4KOK_uYL1qJp9p3ZfKjnpNBDzivEkHA3-JeeobqgO1cKOJK6jW1XkgRaH6aCKOcukz9yew%3D%3D)

clean_body: Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help, and it was even harder to get it. | Peter, In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and even harder to get it. Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives. I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength. I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral. I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it. But now that I'm running for office, A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me. The ad is titled "The Real Herschel Walker," but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people. Every hour that Democrats attack me without our campaign having the ability to refute their lies with our own ads, we're at a tremendous disadvantage. They are desperate enough to crawl into the gutter with false attacks against me personally. name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: Five Years Later: Hurricane Harvey’s Lesson Endures
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
It’s been five years since Hurricane Harvey hit Houston and the Texas Gulf Coast. It was a defining moment for our community and for our campaign.
Harvey arrived five years ago today, bringing more than 50 inches of rain and more than $125 billion in damage. It also brought some of the best advice I’ve ever gotten for trying times, advice I think of each day: Just show up.
After Harvey, so many people wanted to help but were unsure of just how — where to go, what to do. The message came back loud and clear: Just show up. And they did. Houstonians showed up for each other everywhere that people were needed. At shelters. At flooded homes. At food pantries. The outpouring of help and support during Harvey remains its definition for many.
For me, Harvey’s enduring lesson is that one: When there are problems to solve, when there are people in need, when there is work to do, you don’t need to wait to be asked to help, and you don’t need to know exactly what to do, you just need to care and to be there to do what you can.
It’s been five years, but it is as true today as it was then. Because we have real problems to solve in our community and in our country. And each of us can do something about it. We just have to show up.
Vote. Get other people to vote. Knock on doors for a candidate. Make phone calls. Send texts. Write postcards. Remind people how much their vote matters. And how much we can do if we all just show up in November — in Texas and across the country.
So many of you already are and I’m so grateful to you for that.
Together, we can do anything,

# Friends,

Campaign season is slowly gearing up again! From Thursday 9/1 to Saturday 9/3, we will be holding a weekend of action.

**Thursday, 9/1 - Community Conversation-Raiser at 6:45pm in Wheaton Park**
[Facebook Event Page](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=68b91eaddb&e=db24e76724)
I want to hear your worries, complaints, concerns, hopes, and ideas for how Hagerstown can be better represented! We'll be joined by other local representatives and candidates, including Shawn Perry for State Senate, for a great conversation on how we can move forward together.

**Friday, 9/2 - Door-knocking Kickoff (LOCATION TBA)**
We'll be joined by the campaigns of Congressman David Trone and Shawn Perry for State Senate to hit the pavement in Hagerstown and connect with voters.

**Saturday, 9/3 - Door-knocking Day Two (LOCATION TBA)**

Peter — 62 days ago, the U.S. Supreme Court robbed the people of their right to control their bodies and personal health care decisions. For two months, we have been living in a country _dragged backward_ by anti-abortion politicians, conservative justices on the U.S. Supreme Court, and other federal judges. We have heard the horrifying stories across the country, and now is the time for us to fight back here in Oregon to keep our fundamental right to control our own bodies. Everyone — no matter their background or how they became pregnant — deserves the freedom to make personal health care decisions that impact their lives, health, and future.
With _Roe_ gone, and abortion rights up to each state's discretion, governors across the country have become the last line of defense in protecting reproductive freedom.

body:
Our campaign doesn’t just campaign.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220825-3331-header&t=1&akid=3331%2E2526796%2E-bIP_P)
At Team AOC, we believe it’s our responsibility to organize and support our community year-round, not just before Election Day. And right now, that means helping families in The Bronx and Queens with the daunting task of starting a new school year.
Every year, we work with community partners to distribute free backpacks and school supplies to local students. This year, we are distributing _over 1,000_!
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220825.rKDODj&refcode=em20220825-3331-P_FND_ANO_HWH&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3331%2E2526796%2E-bIP_P)
But our work doesn’t end there. Once school gets started again, we know many students struggle to complete homework or access tutoring services. So, we use our robust community of volunteers to help fill in those gaps!
In 2020, we put out a call to volunteers who could help with virtual tutoring and homework assistance, and were able to train and match hundreds of tutors with local parent-teacher organizations. **Alexandria even tutored a student herself!**
The Homework Helpers program is still going strong, providing constituents of NY-14 with one hour of free virtual homework help per week.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220825.rKDODj&refcode=em20220825-3331-P_FND_ANO_HWH&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3331%2E2526796%2E-bIP_P)
We’re proud to organize and support programming that other campaigns wouldn’t, and that’s only possible because of the support we get from small-dollar, grassroots donations from emails like this one.
[If you agree that our responsibilities extend beyond electioneering each November, please pitch in $3 if you’re able to help power our Back to School programming and support. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220825.rKDODj&refcode=em20220825-3331-P_FND_ANO_HWH&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3331%2E2526796%2E-bIP_P)

We know this is an expensive time of year for most families, but if you have any amount to spare, we’d appreciate any amount you can give to support our programming that helps families during this stressful time.
Thank you,
Team AOC

Peter,

Did you hear the news? In a nod to his left-wing base, President Biden today announced that he was “ _**cancelling**_ ” student loan debt for a group of mostly younger Americans.

You read that right. Student takes a loan ... student benefits from the loan ... but when it comes time for student to pay back the money they borrowed, **the President decides that their debt is cancelled**.

But think about it for a moment: _**Can student debt really be “cancelled” like that?**_ Does the debt just “**go away** ”, as the name suggests? **It doesn’t take an economics major to tell you the answer is “No!”.**

**[I want to know where you stand personally on student debt forgiveness.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=a2c4daf093c548c9abbb3155811842a6&_e=wbFsFYgiwknXRmRxbNQo6g3IZ8oMqylTeYBUYNt7_ZStrYLWsLACW20S2nLEK1SS57s0su9sDeN_Dyc2hUN7eyPssmxLHX0Jd2M80SNJMUxUxn5FMwP406cbNjUpA73ux-t6uUJayZWE2qUPDUCif1ybXfCA-2lyENIxMQBRUjxi6Hal22yV9TtohklLHwB_L0LnLbBOHYdr1zBjW7ovWoQuzHOwnNPJ6mJb4nJa86mDNW6ntXZ1iV1-TDembyGB2JBcHUMOySdZbgBYObmC0-M80Yk3fqkHuWcYJKAL5Duy_wGiqJ-ileNSiweFOiUp)** Do you support it, or do you believe, like I do, that cancelling student loan debt is the wrong policy?

[** DO YOU AGREE
WITH BIDEN'S DEBT CANCELLATION? **](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=a2c4daf093c548c9abbb3155811842a6&_e=wbFsFYgiwknXRmRxbNQo6g3IZ8oMqylTeYBUYNt7_ZStrYLWsLACW20S2nLEK1SS57s0su9sDeN_Dyc2hUN7eyPssmxLHX0Jd2M80SNJMUxUxn5FMwP406cbNjUpA73ux-t6uUJayZWE2qUPDUCif1ybXfCA-2lyENIxMQBRUjyUCDiB8o3NUW0_lZd774Lr7hbZNC0-oxsT--VIY1vlrGt08LpO_B1fqAqbbjx-QNHFU5uX1Sl6Cttj9vRSo5SidQzbvBuYIWpmxMMaE8xuTXvYCLZg8toV0CUrLZBVLTkbv2ILoMXF-h4S4D3iHMJP)

Every dollar that’s borrowed must be paid back. But what Biden announced today is that these loans won’t be paid back by the people who took the loans. **Rather, they’ll be paid back by taxpayers like us!**

**Just to appease his most socialist supporters on the left, and in an attempt to energize younger voters before what is shaping up to be a difficult election for Democrats, Biden just launched a quarter-trillion-dollar tax and spend program that promotes fiscal irresponsibility and unfair treatment of those who took out students loans and paid them back.**

Michael suggested I reach out to you, friend. I’m Brittany Pettersen, candidate for Colorado’s 7th Congressional District. I’ve served in the Colorado legislature for 10 years, and now I’m running for Congress. Let me tell you why. I was born and raised in Colorado. I came from a working-class family that faced a LOT of adversity. And I paid my own way by working more jobs than I count: I started cleaning houses when I was just 12 years old, worked behind the counter at a bagel shop, pushed carts at a grocery store, and waited tables at restaurant after restaurant. But in many ways, I was lucky. I had access to great public schools and teachers that believed in me. Because of the investments this community made in me, I was given a chance to earn a good life. I became the first in my family to graduate from both high school and college. I’m running for Congress because there is far too much at stake in this election. The same opportunities I had growing up have been put further and further out of reach for far too many Coloradans. [**I’m traveling across Colorado to talk to voters, and to make sure they know that I’ll fight for them in Congress. But doing that takes resources, team, and we have a huge fundraising deadline coming up at the end of the month. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Nancy Pelosi is BLOCKING a bill to expand Social Security benefits for
seniors. All while she crafts a bill to give the rich a tax break.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113433?refcode=em20220825-24874&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=24874%2E1203867%2EIPk8zT ]Text from the American Prospect reads: Nancy Pelosi’s office is
blocking Social Security expansion, while Congress prepares to pass a
windfall for rich retirees, insurance companies, and large asset managers
like Vanguard and Fidelity. Source: American Prospect

This is what corporate Democrats call "incremental progress," but we’re
calling it unacceptable. There’s no excuse for holding up a bill to give
folks relying on social security a little more support each month. And we
know the rich don’t need more tax breaks (the GOP have given them plenty).

Justice Democrats will always fight to strengthen the social safety net.
We will always fight to elect progressives who will govern for the 99%,
not corporations and the rich. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113433?refcode=em20220825-24874&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=24874%2E1203867%2EIPk8zT ]Can you chip in $3 to
help us elect more progressives who will stand up to Democratic
leadership? We must re-elect and expand the Squad in November.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113433?refcode=em20220825-24874&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=24874%2E1203867%2EIPk8zT ]Contribute

We shouldn’t be seeing these headlines with Democrats in control of
Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113433?refcode=em20220825-24874&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=24874%2E1203867%2EIPk8zT ]Headline text from the American Prospect reads: House Leadership Delays
Social Security Expansion While Crafting Tax Breaks for Rich Retirees
Source: American Prospect

Social Security 2100 is a bill co-sponsored by more than 200 Democrats in
the House. It would be the first expansion of Social Security benefits in
50 years — funded by a payroll tax on wages above $400,000. Right now,
there’s actually a cap on how much income is taxed for Social Security —
allowing folks making more money to avoid paying their fair share into the
critical benefits program. This is a no-brainer piece of legislation for
Democrats — but Pelosi is blocking it.

Instead, House leadership is poised to pass a bill that creates new tax
breaks for those making the most income, which is in turn a gift to
financial firms managing retirement portfolios.

At key moments, Alexandria, Cori, Jamaal, Rashida, Ilhan, and Ayanna have
stood up against corporate Democrats, voted against House leadership, and
upheld their promise to legislate for the people. We need MORE Justice
Democrats in Congress, and every day we’re working towards expanding our
JD bloc on Capitol Hill.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113433?refcode=em20220825-24874&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=24874%2E1203867%2EIPk8zT ]So, can you help us elect Justice Democrats, not just the same
corporate Democrats, with a donation today?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113433?refcode=em20220825-24874&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=24874%2E1203867%2EIPk8zT ]Contribute

Thanks for being in this fight with us.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

name: Will Bertellotti
subject: Share your Sustainability Stories with OLCV!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters and authorized by Andrea Salinas for Congress
body:
| | | Dear supporter, As the 2022 midterm election looms close on the horizon, OLCV needs to hear from you more than ever. Specifically, we’re looking for any “sustainability stories” you might be willing to share with us, as our elected officials need to know about the positive effects that clean energy or sustainable practices have had on the lives of the everyday people of Oregon just like you. Stories stick with people. They persuade people better than any facts or figures ever could, and with your stories, we hope to convince our lawmakers that climate legislation is not just good for the planet, _but for people as well!_ _**Share your story by emailing it to[ olcv@olcv.org](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49760784/363368010/1866524121?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA0NjE4ZTNkLWQ3MjQtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ztoS_O5gJ1GY5wFGgmtdqf0BhXmthzh3jO0kSs4xX1s=&emci=7f54daf5-b924-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=04618e3d-d724-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) using the subject “Sustainability Stories.”**_ **Have you:** switched to a heat pump to control the temperature of your house and felt far more comfortable this summer because of it? Made the transition from a fossil fuel-burning car to driving an electric vehicle, riding a bicycle, or taking public transportation to and from work, and seen a difference in your budget or mental health? Replaced your heavy polluter methane gas stove with an electric induction stove, and found that it cooks like a charm? Installed solar panels on your house and noticed how efficient of a power source they are? Taken up the habit of composting to feed plots at your community garden with strong nutrients, leading to a delicious harvest? Made concrete efforts at your small business to diminish its output of emissions? _Or, have you been itching to live more sustainably or switch to clean energy, but felt that there was something holding you back? _ Then you’re exactly the type of person whose stories we want to hear! In short, we’re looking for your positive experiences with making a switch to clean or electric energy, or more broadly by integrating environmentally sustainable practices into your life. However, we also want to hear from those who yearn to live in a more eco-friendly manner, but are unable to due to personal or systemic barriers preventing them from reasonably making such changes. The more compelling stories we are able to collect about how clean energy and sustainability have positively impacted lives, as well as testimonies about the structural blocks in place preventing access to such choices, the more likely we'll be to sway lawmakers in the direction of removing those blocks and prioritizing climate. Ultimately, our personal choices alone cannot stop climate change— a crisis caused largely by corporations that can only be truly addressed by systemic change. However, if we can collect enough stories to share with our elected officials, we’ll have a better shot at passing meaningful climate action in Oregon by showing them how much we all have to gain through a just transition to a clean energy economy. **To submit your tales of sustainability, clean energy, making the switch to electric, or the barriers you’ve faced in pursuing these changes, email[ olcv@olcv.org](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49760785/363368011/1866524121?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA0NjE4ZTNkLWQ3MjQtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ztoS_O5gJ1GY5wFGgmtdqf0BhXmthzh3jO0kSs4xX1s=&emci=7f54daf5-b924-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=04618e3d-d724-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) using the subject line “Sustainability Stories”** with anywhere from _1-5 paragraphs describing your experience, including details about the lifestyle shift, why you made it, and how it’s positively altered your life – or if you’re writing about the challenges stopping you from taking up greener consumption habits – describe what factors are in your way, and why we need to get rid of them to guarantee equitable access to eco-friendly living for all. _ We will be accepting story submissions for an extended period of time, and hope to put your stories to good use by uplifting them on our website and social media platforms. We also plan to share our favorite stories with elected leaders to illustrate the immense benefits Oregon’s population could reap from substantive legislation to protect our climate and shift our state towards 100% clean energy. Thank you, we can’t wait to hear your stories! Will Bertellotti
Communications Coordinator, OLCV. |

Fellow American,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

body:
Fellow Conservative,

We’ve all recently seen why it’s even more critical now that our Republican candidates win at all levels in the rapidly approaching 2022 Midterm Elections.

The radical Biden Democrats have escalated their abuse of power against the American people by pushing the so-called “Inflation Reduction Act” on Capitol Hill - which hangs another $739 billion spending boondoggle on American taxpayers to hire thousands and thousands of new IRS agents - and actually makes inflation worse as we slide further into the Biden Recession.

Fellow Conservative, as a top Republican supporter, you understand the historic need to win new GOP Majorities in both Houses of Congress - and win state and local races across the country - to sweep the radical, destructive Democrats out of power and bring Joe Biden’s disastrous agenda to a screeching halt.

Now it’s time to tell you how your Republican National Committee is planning to make that happen.

**Exceptional ground game.**

If you’re wondering what that means, let me explain. The RNC is recruiting thousands of volunteers to go door to door as well as call residents in communities across the nation.

Peter,

I'm terribly sorry to drop into your inbox like this, but I'm humbly asking you to read this all the way through.

If you get to the end and still think your $13 donation doesn't matter, then you may find yourself paying more at the pump, in the grocery store, and on Tax Day.

Yesterday, a Trump Impeachment Manager became the official Democrat nominee I will face in November, and two polls show me TIED with her. I can't stress this enough, I have to reach my August Goal to show that conservatives are fired up to restore America to greatness. We have two options about what to do next:
1. Let a Trump Impeachment Manager continue to outraise and outspend us on TV until she wins Florida and Democrats keep the Senate.

This is a dark day for Texas. | | | Peter, Today Texas’ “Trigger Abortion Ban” law has officially gone into effect. Our state has been making headlines around abortion access over the past couple of years for becoming more and more strict around abortion care — and today, restrictions and penalties have gotten even harsher. Doctors in Texas who perform abortions are now looking at felony charges and the possibility of life in prison — and exceptions to save the lives of pregnant patients are incredibly thin. This is a dark day for Texas. This is the third significant abortion ban in our state — and together, all of these laws disproportionately harm the most vulnerable Texans: people of color, immigrants, low-income, uninsured people, and young people. In short, we’re looking at a full abortion ban in the state of Texas. Peter, this is exactly the type of situation we were worried about when we talked about the possibility of Roe v. Wade being overturned. And this issue is not just about abortion — it’s about dignity, bodily autonomy, healthcare, and so much more. We know that the majority of Texans did not want this type of extreme abortion ban in place. So why aren’t our representatives listening to us? ¡Vamos por Quince! body:
| | | [](http://links.sarahkleehoodny.com/u/click?_t=4042bf8ec2414cd7ba40b5db51a7d947&_m=9f3082b4c0ea421085360019ce51c908&_e=M7UKPO5I34Ekt4f3HiaBmb3iTAWywDlw2LJP-M87Kntc6cWws6kSdTM7CI8TFA_2jZw1p5Nzy4NlaiX-oujBCO72wKo_c2XcSjZJc1xrG3JQvzCnkitofUi0WUQatdkJiXfBMsGUkQ2JNjaeDAZtcs8VD92WaKbnuAEwkQXb-KEi5xN17XupoBBB85gqPtHTGTUKxC41jIrGRRmEabWicVNxAiHUetNCYHGnjF_fQBumZf6W8HjXianTYP0_b2PpPhpx8fMcRL3iFq63bjdVkApAE22Mj11SW1tjmrqX56P8lA57AX-EEGDlhmOn1n2Bh-j_jE_GVa3mPKoImO5eA7YDlaByv8ixhqXVmkUyPiP9TLCbn2Y_EMhBAlRzYt5nGNiYLsxQdcuXulwJ69k5yRSVHS84Vd_x0YLajcf0haSuLwxFdcpEH1Xq56AwMMrz) Team,I want to start by saying that I am incredibly grateful for your support. You all have demonstrated remarkable dedication to this campaign, and I couldn’t have gotten so close to beating my opponent without you. The final tally of votes was ~10K for my main opponent compared to ~9K for me.Together, we just proved that candidates without connections or wealth can compete at the highest levels. What you may not realize is that:
* I never raised enough money to stop working full-time at my job, while serving as an elected Town Councilor and also raising my two daughters.
* We were out-funded 12 to 1. My main opponent had 1.6M (1.1 M + 500K in SuperPAC support) against my 130K in grassroots donations.
* My entire team (except for 1 full-time and 1 part-time member) were volunteers!

I was working against the stigma that big money is needed to win, so thank you for keeping me in the race! Although I did not win on Tuesday, I am still energized by the community support and looking toward the future. However, as I look toward the future, I am confronting the fact that this race has left the campaign in a bit of debt. **[Please consider donating any amount to help us pay off this final bit of debt.](http://links.sarahkleehoodny.com/u/click?_t=4042bf8ec2414cd7ba40b5db51a7d947&_m=9f3082b4c0ea421085360019ce51c908&_e=M7UKPO5I34Ekt4f3HiaBmb3iTAWywDlw2LJP-M87Kntc6cWws6kSdTM7CI8TFA_2jZw1p5Nzy4NlaiX-oujBCO72wKo_c2XcSjZJc1xrG3JQvzCnkitofUi0WUQatdkJiXfBMsGUkQ2JNjaeDAZtcs8VD92WaKbnuAEwkQXb-KEi5xN17XupoBBB85gqPtHTGTUKxC41jIrGRRmEabWicVNxAiHUetNCYHGnjF_fQBumZf6W8HjXianTYP0_b2PpPhpx8fMcRL3iFq63bjdVkAcECBgBrYa64_q_dApHHp3gF7RxRMRjEqL84GKIT1N0eDq0YAHo0veDYiYvRMpH52PQznThY6xi-RHQBHiqIJnmKQrvDWv9vJkrWOAtOwh2JcNQAPQNRR4gNaG8nAaNDbjZgRN2TEfmlDko3a7LGrlfGG5_mNtnQTl28jeFboVi)** We did the numbers last night, and it looks like we owe 5K in debt and another 25K in loans. This is the true price of the campaign and a cost I was ready to accrue. **[However, I wanted to reach out to see if any of you could help ease the burden of debt that we are facing for running a grassroots campaign.](http://links.sarahkleehoodny.com/u/click?_t=4042bf8ec2414cd7ba40b5db51a7d947&_m=9f3082b4c0ea421085360019ce51c908&_e=M7UKPO5I34Ekt4f3HiaBmb3iTAWywDlw2LJP-M87Kntc6cWws6kSdTM7CI8TFA_2jZw1p5Nzy4NlaiX-oujBCO72wKo_c2XcSjZJc1xrG3JQvzCnkitofUi0WUQatdkJiXfBMsGUkQ2JNjaeDAZtcs8VD92WaKbnuAEwkQXb-KEi5xN17XupoBBB85gqPtHTGTUKxC41jIrGRRmEabWicVNxAiHUetNCYHGnjF_fQBumZf6W8HjXianTYP0_b2PpPhpx8fMcRL3iFq63bjdVkLYmtGdzT9hGkxQWnUXP3YCt2gu5hSGV9xUFxS5rxk-LLPaswK0eEhkKIYK0VVr8LlgLuZMBSj1JieckRLoAYq7PPiyn4St_cwH6bbjG5PMz7RY_vTjLD5bzJU6yCkYysXuoNIBT5hlkzhp9ZOq8fqAjWfC5WF8fEhrCDIvxljGZ)** I know times are tough. We all have debt and loans. If any of you can chip into paying off the last bit of debt, it would mean the world.The cost of not taking dark money from corporations is taking on the responsibility of campaign costs personally. I am proud that I remained true to my values and my integrity. I can sleep well at night knowing this campaign was funded by me and by the people alone.Most importantly, please support all Democrats this November. It is critical that we control the House and the Senate. We need these seats to protect our children, women's choice, marriage equality, and to fight for a more fair and just society.Thank you all,
Sarah Klee Hood Paid for by Sarah Klee Hood for NY

Josh grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood of Endicott, NY.

Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about.

body:

| | [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=d8c3da7184&e=7dd0b93d07)

| |
---
| Peter,

When I first ran for mayor, it was to stop politicians in my community who were on the take at the expense of the people they were elected to serve. I ran to make sure my community didn’t fall to corrupt practices and political opportunists, and to ensure that it remained a place where you could build a business and a life.

History has a way of repeating itself. Now I am running to push back on the self-dealing politicians in Congress, who drove up the cost of gas and groceries, and made our communities less safe.

This week, the [Washington Free Beacon reported](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=4793c162cd&e=7dd0b93d07) that Sean Casten’s latest financial disclosure shows he holds up to $500,000 in a green energy company that will likely benefit from Green Energy spending.

This is a disturbing pattern with Sean Casten. In 2008, he secured $8 million in taxpayer-funded subsidies for his family’s company from the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act. As a Congressman, he has pushed for similar special deals to benefit his own company, and special interests.

Rather than reforming the system, Sean Casten works the system. His cheerleading of the “Don’t Say Inflation” Act is insulting. Casten is a lobbyist-turned-congressman who has taken millions of dollars in federal subsidies for years - subsidies for which the hard-working taxpayers in DuPage and Cook County have to foot the bill. He ran for Congress to ensure that he could continue to secure those subsidies. Something that he has done once again. Sean Casten has done little to make life better for anyone in the Sixth District but continues to enrich himself.

As Mayor of Orland Park, I’ve worked to make government live within its means so we could reduce the burden the village was passing on to the people we serve. In positions of trust, I’ve always stood up for the people I served—as an officer of the United States Air Force, as a business owner, and as mayor of Orland Park. I will continue that record of service in Washington DC.

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
_Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District_

| **South Cook News: Casten Ensured Tax Breaks on Luxury Cars for the Wealthy**

While the Democrats’ “Don’t Say Inflation” Act does little to reduce inflation, it was a major boon for the Green Energy lobby. The bill is laden with federal subsidies and tax carve-outs for the powerful special interests’ preferred constituencies.

For example, now only electric vehicles assembled in North America qualify for the $7500 electric vehicle tax credit. According to a preliminary list released by the US government, the majority of vehicles that will qualify are high-end models: Audi, BMW, GMC Hummer, Lincoln, Tesla, Cadillac, Mercedes and Ford Mustang...

Keith Pekau, GOP Nominee for Congress (IL-06) released the following statement: “The EV tax credits are yet another example of how the “Don’t Say Inflation” Act puts special interests and the wealthy ahead of working people. If you can afford an Audi or a Mercedes, you can get a tax break. If you are a single, working mom who can only scratch together enough for a used Toyota: too bad. Sean Casten, who drives a Tesla, was gleeful about passing this bill to benefit himself, his wealthy buddies and the Green Lobby. He didn’t give any consideration to those who are struggling under the Biden-Casten economy...”

[Read the full release here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=94f85fa11e&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
|
---
|
# **_Connecting the Dots_**
---
| **The Reports Are In: Inflations Causes Pain in a Variety of Ways**
Americans have historically been a resilient and optimistic group, but they are hurting right now as a result of the Biden-Casten agenda. Beyond the burden of skyrocketing gas and energy costs, here are some of the other ways people are being hit.

**[NPR](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=cb451eb2be&e=7dd0b93d07): These are some of the ways inflation is changing Americans' spending habits**
Tom Charley's family has been selling groceries in the Pittsburgh area for four generations, through lots of economic ups and downs. Even his father, who ran stores during the [high inflation of the 1970s and '80s](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=5676b7ceec&e=7dd0b93d07) has never seen a period quite like this.

"It's a challenge, for sure. There's no doubt about it," Tom Charley says.

**[CBS](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=644b90d806&e=7dd0b93d07): Tailgating Costs this Football Season Higher than Ever Before Due to Inflation, Economists Say**
Economists said rising prices mean tailgating costs will be higher than ever before.

Chicken, like wings, is 17% more expensive than last year. Beef is up 10% and condiments like ketchup, relish, and mustard, all saw double-digit increases this year.

Economists recommend considering investing in a better TV instead of spending the money on a single game.

**[Business Insider](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=945c31d9ae&e=7dd0b93d07): I Compared My Grocery Bills from the Last Year and Found Inflation Means My Costs Have Ballooned by Over 18% a Month**
I decided to start looking at my grocery shops from back in April 2021, since that's when we first saw inflation rates really shoot up. That month the inflation rate was 4.2%, nearly double the 2.6% rate in March 2021. Since then, the rate of inflation has grown exponentially month after month and capped out at 9.1% in June 2022. July 2022 saw interest rates drop a bit, but at 8.5%, inflation is still shockingly high.

name: Team Slotkin
subject: A deep dive into campaign ads
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220825&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220825&amount=28]
Team,
Campaigns are unpredictable – which is why here on Team Slotkin, we like to be prepared.
We recently got word that the cost of television ads is skyrocketing for the next few weeks. Our main goal with these emails is to keep you in the loop about what’s happening in Elissa’s race, which is why she broke down the ins and outs of how campaign ads work and why this is happening in an email yesterday. We’ve included it below to make sure you saw.
This is definitely a speed bump in the race to the election – but luckily we’ve spent the last year preparing for things like this to happen in the last stretch of the campaign. Which is why we’re asking if you would send a few bucks our way as we continue to get Elissa’s message out to the new 7th district. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220825&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220825&amount=28]
Team Slotkin
Team,
One of the most important parts of running a campaign is getting advertisements up on TV – especially in this election. In addition to our massive door-to-door efforts and our district events, they’re just about the best way to reach voters in our new district. Michigan still watches plenty of TV.
So today I thought I’d give you a bit of a behind-the-scenes look at how exactly this part of the campaign works, and a recent development that has thrown a bit of a wrench into things.
We purchase TV advertisements directly from the television stations, who set their own prices. Pretty straightforward, but here’s where I’ll get into the weeds: in the 60 days leading up to the general election, by law TV stations must charge candidates the “Lowest Unit Rate” to advertise. That’s September 9th - November 8th. Essentially, that means that in the 60 days leading up to the election, stations are not allowed to charge candidates exorbitant rates to communicate with voters – even if demand for ad time is high.
But, this rule only applies to candidates themselves – not to any Super PAC or organization that might be running ads on their behalf. The outside organizations continue to pay market rates for advertisements – which increase as Election Day gets closer, and more and more entities are vying for a finite amount of TV time.
With the amount of spending we’ve seen in preparation for the fall, we estimate that market rates for those outside organizations could be *9 times* as expensive as the candidate rate. That’s why your money goes a lot further when you contribute directly to a campaign, rather than an organization.
Where things can get complicated is in the few weeks before that 60 day window begins. Before September 9th, stations can charge candidates whatever prices they want. I’ve had three campaign ads up on TV starting on July 5th (you can see them here) [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpZaVXq7xHeiFQTPBqFC4gQ] . But now that we’re approaching that 60 day window, the price to keep those ads on the air has skyrocketed.
Last week, rates jumped THREE TIMES AS HIGH as they will be between September 9th and the election – all because television stations are capitalizing on being able to set their own prices in the next few weeks.
For a year and a half, I’ve stressed the importance of early money and how it allows us to be nimble in the event of unforeseen issues. And waking up to find out TV time has jumped to 3 times more expensive than it was yesterday is what we call an unforeseen issue.
Because of the generosity of folks who have already donated, this is a change we can absorb. But it does force us to make changes in our budget. We're currently working to make up for the more expensive TV time, which is the principal reason I’m emailing you today.
Any chance you’d be willing to chip in to help my ads stay on the air at the same frequency? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220825&amount=28] That would help tremendously, as well as with any more curveballs between now and Election Day.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220825&amount=28]
Elissa

| Hi, it's John Fetterman -- Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania + Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate.

You wanna talk about why American elections are so messed up? Let's start with the number 29, because it tells you everything you need to know.

👉 **The average donation to our campaign for U.S. Senate is $29.**

In order to raise all the money it takes to win this race for you + me + PA, we've received a mind boggling 582,000 contributions. Now, you might be thinking: "Why the hell would John Fetterman need 582,000 $29 donations"

Allow me to explain:

👉 **A big super PAC called "Senate Leadership Fund" (name sounds really nice, huh?) booked $29 MILLION+ in TV and radio ads to attack me + boost Dr. Oz.**

Listen, the GOP is booking TV advertising attacks against Democrats like me and Voter Protection Project nationally. And as much as I hate to admit it, we know from experience that when super PACs beat people over the head with these stupid 30-second ads... they can drag you down in the polls.

**So I 'm emailing you today for something entirely predictable... $29.** Because we need to ensure that Democrats like me win in November. And, without a whole bunch of you, we aren't going to be able to push back against this huge negative ad campaign. [**So, can you make a $29 donation (or more or less, it really doesn 't matter) to me and Voter Protection Project? Seriously every dollar helps when you're up against this kind of super PAC spending.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23272?t=6&akid=4239%2E878179%2EUID6Dm) | [CONTRIBUTE $29 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23272?t=7&akid=4239%2E878179%2EUID6Dm)
---
It shouldn't be this way.

You shouldn't have to be a gazillionaire like Dr. Oz to run for office.

You shouldn't have super PACs spending $29 MILLION to try and sink Democrats like me and Voter Protection Project. But, until we get to the Senate and fight for real campaign finance reform, this is the world we live in. And the only way I know how to beat the Big Money is by energizing as many of YOU as possible to chip in $29 at a time.
**We 've got 7 days left, and the attacks are going to get worse and worse from here on out. [If you can, please make a $29 donation so that Voter Protection Project and I don't fall behind on fundraising + so we can compete toe to toe with the giant super PACs.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23272?t=8&akid=4239%2E878179%2EUID6Dm)**
Me + Gisele + our whole team are so grateful to each and every one of you. It's because of all our grassroots donors and volunteers and supporters that we have a fighting chance to go up against all that big money and WIN.
[CONTRIBUTE $29 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23272?t=9&akid=4239%2E878179%2EUID6Dm)

subject: My recent op-ed in the WSJ
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help, and it was even harder to get it. |
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=cfede1f4624340a9869e03bfbbcb5bbe&_e=YiQUT2OVEp2L8C2wdeMoxfm1hB6ADUtqGkBebEC2M_16qeD3Xp40PAwvt5-BwBRALCi0JgV7EBdYJ4WxX_rnlBFNBJaFc00eDOLfFddkqRQwYZizEY4zim93rvQ7Hfl6krb_8SLxEQXSoNi7-JSKlhersuEPEYSIgegRBF775ZfyN28G1l0OxBCzECF29hbb3STn3jFVFVSSn16XNrOn4emSTZr7T4TIp8onIv2AgLByYkNTINUMRVipUJ5tZUYPy_kKR11hvCIv09rjObJDWESvb85wKKLb_KFd9fySg0hF8k-HmINYPhFMh5GU5O0pjJTTVFAILdd6uOUYgs_yIlyPPFbTJ-EZIO6o_AdATRMknhmGP0MJk59B4ScBF9ADYYsDO1_F0jU0EztX8skBvPFe9KGIH5l1rE1gwDvuEDf1pEKe7gqSd6qaPyaIi80V)

---
Peter,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

But now that I'm running for office, **[my struggle has become the subject of a nasty and dishonest attack ad.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=cfede1f4624340a9869e03bfbbcb5bbe&_e=YiQUT2OVEp2L8C2wdeMoxfm1hB6ADUtqGkBebEC2M_16qeD3Xp40PAwvt5-BwBRALCi0JgV7EBdYJ4WxX_rnlBFNBJaFc00eDOLfFddkqRQwYZizEY4zim93rvQ7Hfl6krb_8SLxEQXSoNi7-JSKlhersuEPEYSIgegRBF775ZfyN28G1l0OxBCzECF29hbb3STn3jFVFVSSn16XNrOn4emSTZr7T4TIp8onIv2AgLByYkNTINUMRVipUJ5tZUYPy_kKR11hvCIv09rjObJDWESvb85wKKLb_KFd9fySg0g7HSlxFvNWyiew9LGf07TKQsZqinLdmqdWUPMwS1rfW425o_BoNeuE1RE24WwBX3YVPLyf-yG84TxNd_hzGWVtLEaD9HLcBMUHnJWMJFYyzyYBHILK2fZIg_QHtSAxQc26E0NfjKle1XK6lydBvtmU)** A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me.

The ad is titled **"The Real Herschel Walker,"** but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people.

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=cfede1f4624340a9869e03bfbbcb5bbe&_e=YiQUT2OVEp2L8C2wdeMoxfm1hB6ADUtqGkBebEC2M_16qeD3Xp40PAwvt5-BwBRALCi0JgV7EBdYJ4WxX_rnlBFNBJaFc00eDOLfFddkqRQwYZizEY4zim93rvQ7Hfl6krb_8SLxEQXSoNi7-JSKlhersuEPEYSIgegRBF775ZfyN28G1l0OxBCzECF29hbb3STn3jFVFVSSn16XNrOn4emSTZr7T4TIp8onIv2AgLByYkNTINUMRVipUJ5tZUYPy_kKR11hvCIv09rjObJDWESvb85wKKLb_KFd9fySg0gU6YfRSznuedvJBZLIh1SybtcBuKCAwrOVh7pMXZqVlfM9LGP14LkzF4MS5FZoApC6zrdWFN5cMSVsnjKQTOQO4hMao-ViQ_FfgIb-MHMneHtDL-fmKihikPwx3_SIYTuhr2kUqAsQuIk5mJBi4aSJ)

It was hard to admit you needed help, and it was even harder to get it. | Peter, In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and even harder to get it. Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives. I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength. I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral. I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it. But now that I'm running for office, A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me.
